[Aria] That is true. Now, with this new flight machine, you are able to control a plane. You are able to go up into the sky and look down at the beautiful land.
(那是真的。现在，有了这个新的飞行机器，你能够控制一架飞机。你能够飞上天空，俯瞰美丽的土地。)

[Andrew] How does a person use this flight machine, Aria? Is it hard for a simple person to use?
(一个人要如何使用这个飞行机器，Aria？普通人使用它会很难吗？)

[Aria] It is not hard at all. You do not need a special apparatus. You only need your computer and your hands. You are able to use the keys on your computer to make the plane turn left, turn right, go up, or go down.
(它一点也不难。你不需要特殊的设备。你只需要你的电脑和你的手。你能够使用电脑上的按键来让飞机左转、右转、上升或下降。)

[Andrew] This is of great value for education. Children in school are able to take a journey to any place. They are able to see the high mountains of Europe, the long rivers of America, and the great wall of China.
(这对于教育有很大的价值。学校里的孩子们能够去任何地方旅行。他们能够看到欧洲的高山、美洲的长河和中国的长城。)

[Aria] Yes, it is like a journey without leaving your room. It gives a very clear view of the earth. I have a great desire to make an attempt at this flight machine after our talk.
(是的，这就像是一场不出房间的旅行。它给出了非常清晰的地球视图。在我们的座谈之后，我非常渴望尝试一下这个飞行机器。)

[Andrew] I have made an attempt yesterday. It gave me a feeling of surprise and amusement. You feel like you have wings. It is a beautiful experience.
(我昨天尝试过了。它给我一种惊喜和好玩的感觉。你感觉自己好像有了翅膀。这是一个美丽的体验。)

[Aria] Now let us talk about another play. Rayman Legends Retold is coming to consoles and PC this October.
(现在让我们谈谈另一个游戏。Rayman Legends Retold 将于今年 10 月登陆主机和电脑。)

[Andrew] This is a story that will make many game lovers happy. Rayman is a very old and loved name in the history of plays. The first Rayman play was made many years past.
(这是一个会让许多游戏爱好者高兴的故事。Rayman 在游戏历史上是一个非常古老且受人喜爱的名字。第一款 Rayman 游戏是在许多年前制作的。)

[Aria] Yes, Rayman is a very strange animal. He has no arms and no legs, but his hands and feet are able to move. He is a very happy person who runs and jumps to fight against bad things.
(是的，Rayman 是一个非常奇怪的动物。他没有手臂，也没有腿，但他的手和脚能够移动。他是一个非常快乐的人，通过奔跑和跳跃来与坏事做斗争。)

[Andrew] In this new play, Rayman Legends Retold, the makers are using a new engine. This engine makes the light and the sound much better. The pictures on the glass will be very beautiful.
(在这款新游戏 Rayman Legends Retold 中，制作者们正在使用一个新引擎。这个引擎让光效和声音变得好得多。玻璃屏幕上的画面将会非常美丽。)

[Aria] I have reading about an interview with the developer. They said they are putting new things in this play.
(我读过一篇对开发者的采访。他们说他们正在这个游戏中加入新的东西。)

[Andrew] Yes, they are bringing back a sport play called Kung Foot. It is a play where you kick a ball into a net. It is very quick and full of amusement. You are able to play it with your friends in the same room.
(是的，他们正在带回一个名为 Kung Foot 的体育游戏。这是一个你把球踢进网里的游戏。它非常快且充满了乐趣。你能够和你的朋友在同一个房间里玩它。)

[Aria] There was some discussion about Michel Ancel, the creator of Rayman. He left the company Ubisoft in the past because of some arguments, but he gave help and advice for this new play.
(有一些关于 Rayman 创造者 Michel Ancel 的讨论。他过去因为一些争论离开了 Ubisoft 公司，但他为这款新游戏提供了帮助和建议。)

[Andrew] His advice is very important. He has a great mind for art. His ideas will keep the play true to its history.
(他的建议非常重要。他很有艺术头脑。他的想法将使游戏保持其历史的真实性。)

[Aria] This play will come out in October. I believe a great number of young and old persons will get it for their amusement.
(这款游戏将于 10 月推出。我相信大量的年轻人和老年人都会买它来娱乐。)

[Andrew] Let us move to our next story about hand machines. Samsung phones have 5 hidden parts that many owners do not have knowledge of.
(让我们转到关于手机的下一个故事。Samsung 手机有 5 个隐藏的功能，许多所有者并不知道。)

[Aria] I use a Samsung phone every day, Andrew. I have a desire to have knowledge of these 5 hidden parts. What is the first one?
(我每天都使用 Samsung 手机，Andrew。我渴望了解这 5 个隐藏的功能。第一个是什么？)

[Andrew] The first part is about the camera. You are able to take a picture without touching the phone. You only have to say a word like smile or cheese, and the phone will take the picture automatically.
(第一个功能是关于相机的。你能够在不碰手机的情况下拍照。你只需要说一个词，比如 smile（微笑）或 cheese（奶酪），手机就会自动拍照。)

[Aria] That is very useful when you want to take a picture of a group of friends and your hand is far from the phone. What is the second part?
(当你想要拍一张朋友合照而你的手离手机很远时，那非常有用。第二部分是什么？)

[Andrew] The second part is about sound. The phone is able to make adjustments to the sound based on your age and your hearing. It tests your ears with different sounds and makes the sound perfect for you.
(第二部分是关于声音的。手机能够根据你的年龄和听力对声音进行调整。它用不同的声音测试你的耳朵，并为你做出完美的声音。)

[Aria] That is a very delicate design. It is very good for older persons who have some trouble with their hearing. What is the third part?
(那是一个非常精致的设计。这对于听力有困难的老年人非常好。第三部分是什么？)

[Andrew] The third part is a private box. You are able to put your secret pictures, writings, and accounts in this box. No other person is able to see them without your key or your finger print.
(第三部分是一个私密盒子。你能够把你的秘密照片、文字和账户放在这个盒子里。没有你的钥匙或指纹，其他人是无法看到它们的。)

[Aria] Safety is very important now because we keep our whole life on our phones. What is the fourth part?
(现在安全非常重要，因为我们把整个生活都放在手机上。第四部分是什么？)

[Andrew] The fourth part is about the battery. You are able to set a limit on the battery power. The phone will stop taking power when it gets to 80 percent. This keeps the battery healthy for a long year.
(第四部分是关于电池的。你能够对电池电量设置限制。当电量达到 80% 时，手机将停止充电。这能让电池在长年累月中保持健康。)

[Aria] And what is the fifth hidden part?
(那第五个隐藏的功能是什么？)

[Andrew] The fifth part is a quick way to send files. You are able to send large pictures or writings to another Samsung phone near you very quickly, even when you have no connection to the internet.
(第五部分是快速发送文件的方法。你能够非常快速地将大照片或文字发送到你身边的另一部 Samsung 手机，即使你没有连接到互联网。)

[Aria] These are great suggestions. I will make an attempt to find these parts on my phone tonight.
(这些是很好的建议。我今晚会尝试在我的手机上找到这些功能。)

[Andrew] Speaking of new phones, we have news about the Apple iPhone 18 Pro.
(说到新手机，我们有关于 Apple iPhone 18 Pro 的新闻。)

[Aria] But Andrew, the iPhone 18 Pro is a phone for the future. It will not come out until September 2026. Why are we talking about it now?
(但是 Andrew，iPhone 18 Pro 是未来的手机。它要到 2026 年 9 月才会发布。为什么我们现在要谈论它？)

[Andrew] Because there are many clues from a great meeting of Apple called WWDC 2026. These clues give us a clear picture of what the new phone will be like.
(因为在 Apple 的一次名为 WWDC 2026 的重大网络会议上有很多线索。这些线索让我们对这款新手机的样子有了清晰的了解。)

[Aria] What are the most important details of this future phone?
(这款未来手机最重要的细节是什么？)

[Andrew] First, there is a new color. It is called Dark Cherry. It is a very beautiful, deep red color that is very eye-catching.
(首先，有一种新颜色。它被称为 Dark Cherry（暗樱桃色）。这是一种非常美丽、深沉的红色，非常引人注目。)

[Aria] That sounds very beautiful. What about the size and the design?
(那听起来非常漂亮。尺寸和设计呢？)

[Andrew] The iPhone 18 Pro Max will have a thickness of 8.75 millimeters. This is the same thickness as the iPhone 17 Pro Max. So Apple is keeping the phone very thin and light.
(iPhone 18 Pro Max 的厚度将为 8.75 毫米。这与 iPhone 17 Pro Max 的厚度相同。所以 Apple 保持了手机的纤薄和轻巧。)

[Aria] What about the camera and the battery?
(那相机和电池呢？)

[Andrew] The camera will have a great upgrade. It will have a new system to take very clear pictures in the dark. The battery will also be larger, so you are able to use the phone for a longer time without taking power.
(相机将有重大升级。它将有一个新系统，可以在黑暗中拍出非常清晰的照片。电池也会更大，所以你能够使用手机更长时间而不需要充电。)

[Aria] Apple always makes small adjustments every year, but when you look at a phone from two years in the future, the changes are very great.
(Apple 每年都会做出微小的调整，但当你看到两年后的手机时，变化是非常巨大的。)

[Andrew] Yes. Many persons will have a desire to make the change to this new phone when it comes out in September 2026.
(是的。当这款新手机在 2026 年 9 月发布时，许多人都渴望更换它。)

[Aria] Let us now turn our attention to business and money. SpaceX is planning to have an IPO, which means they will sell parts of the company to the public in the stock market.
(现在让我们把注意力转向商业和金钱。SpaceX 计划进行 IPO，这意味着他们将在股市中向公众出售公司的股份。)

[Andrew] This is a very big event for Wall Street. SpaceX is a company that makes rockets and sends them into space. It is owned by Elon Musk.
(这对于华尔街来说是一个非常重大的事件。SpaceX 是一家制造火箭并将其送入太空的公司。它由 Elon Musk 所有。)

[Aria] Who will be the biggest winners from this SpaceX IPO?
(谁将是这次 SpaceX IPO 的最大赢家？)

[Andrew] The biggest winner is Elon Musk. Because of the high value of SpaceX, his net worth has gone up to a very great amount. He has become the first person on earth with 1,000,000,000,000 dollars.
(最大的赢家是 Elon Musk。由于 SpaceX 的高估值，他的净资产已经上升到了一个非常巨大的数额。他成为了地球上第一个拥有 1,000,000,000,000 美元的人。)

[Aria] 1,000,000,000,000 dollars! That is a number with 12 zeros. It is almost not possible to picture how much money that is.
(1,000,000,000,000 美元！那是一个有 12 个零的数字。几乎无法想象那是多少钱。)

[Andrew] Yes. If you compare your money with his money, the difference is like a small drop of water compared to a great sea.
(是的。如果你把你的钱和他的钱相比，差距就像一小滴水与大海相比。)

[Aria] Why is SpaceX valued so high by the market?
(为什么 SpaceX 被市场估值如此之高？)

[Andrew] Because they are doing things that no other company is able to do. They have a system called Starlink that sends internet to the whole earth from space. They are also making great rockets to send men and women to the Moon and Mars.
(因为他们正在做其他公司无法做到的事情。他们有一个名为 Starlink 的系统，从太空向整个地球发送互联网。他们还在制造大型火箭，将男女送上月球和火星。)

[Aria] The stock market is very excited about this. Some experts say the market is at a 10 out of 10 because of AI and SpaceX.
(股市对此非常兴奋。一些专家表示，由于 AI 和 SpaceX，市场处于 10 分（满分 10 分）的状态。)

[Andrew] Yes, there is a great desire for growth in these new industries. It is a time of great change for business.
(是的，这些新行业有着强烈的增长欲望。这是商业发生巨大变革的时期。)

[Aria] Let us talk about another transport company. JetBlue is betting big on Fort Lauderdale.
(让我们谈谈另一家运输公司。JetBlue 正在 Fort Lauderdale 下大赌注。)

[Andrew] Fort Lauderdale is a city in Florida, in the south of the US. JetBlue is making it a great international gateway for flights to other countries.
(Fort Lauderdale 是美国南部佛罗里达州的一个城市。JetBlue 正在将其打造成飞往其他国家的重大国际门户。)

[Aria] What are they building there to make it better?
(他们正在那里建造什么来让它变得更好？)

[Andrew] They are building a new airport lounge. This is a beautiful and quiet room where travelers are able to rest, have a drink, and eat food before they get on their plane.
(他们正在建造一个新的机场休息室。这是一个美丽而安静的房间，旅行者可以在上飞机前在这里休息、喝饮料和吃食物。)

[Aria] This is very good for travelers who have to wait for a long time. Why did JetBlue select Fort Lauderdale?
(这对于需要等待很长时间的旅行者来说非常好。为什么 JetBlue 选择 Fort Lauderdale？)

[Andrew] Because it is near the sea and a great number of persons go there for travel. It is also a very good position to send flights to Latin America and the islands in the south.
(因为这里临海，有大量的人去那里旅游。它也是向拉丁美洲和南部岛屿发送航班的非常好的位置。)

[Aria] So JetBlue wants to compete with other great airlines in that area.
(所以 JetBlue 想要与该地区的其他大型航空公司竞争。)

[Andrew] Yes, they want to give better service and cheaper prices to get more customers.
(是的，他们希望提供更好的服务和更便宜的价格，以吸引更多客户。)

[Aria] Our next story is about AI and the government. It is about how Amazon and the White House ended Anthropic's Fable.
(我们的下一个故事是关于 AI 和政府的。它是关于 Amazon 和白宫如何结束了 Anthropic 的 Fable。)

[Andrew] This is a very serious story about safety and control. Anthropic is a company that makes very strong AI models. One of their models was called Mythos.
(这是一个关于安全和控制的非常严肃的故事。Anthropic 是一家制造非常强大的 AI 模型的公司。他们的其中一个模型被称为 Mythos。)

[Aria] What was Fable, Andrew?
(Fable 是什么，Andrew？)

[Andrew] Fable was a project to let foreign nationals use their strong AI model. But the US government was very worried about this.
(Fable 是一个让外国国民使用他们强大 AI 模型的项目。但美国政府对此非常担心。)

[Aria] Why was the government worried about foreign persons using AI?
(政府为什么担心外国人使用 AI？)

[Andrew] They had fear that other nations might use this strong AI for bad purposes, like making weapons, doing damage to computer systems, or fighting against the US.
(他们担心其他国家可能会将这种强大的 AI 用于坏的目的，比如制造武器、破坏电脑系统或与美国对抗。)

[Aria] So what did the White House do?
(那么白宫做了什么？)

[Andrew] The Trump administration gave a very quick demand to Anthropic. They said Anthropic had only 90 minutes to take down Fable.
(Trump 政府向 Anthropic 提出了非常快速的要求。他们说 Anthropic 只有 90 分钟的时间来关闭 Fable。)

[Aria] Only 90 minutes! That is a very short time. What did Anthropic do?
(只有 90 分钟！那是一个非常短的时间。Anthropic 做了什么？)

[Andrew] They had to stop all access to the Mythos model for foreign nationals immediately. Amazon, which supports Anthropic with much money and computer power, also had to act very quickly to stop the project.
(他们必须立即停止外国国民对 Mythos 模型的所有访问。在资金和电脑算力上支持 Anthropic 的 Amazon 也必须非常迅速地行动以停止该项目。)

[Aria] Some newspapers say Anthropic is reaping what it sowed because they talked too much about the dangers of AI in the past.
(一些报纸说 Anthropic 是自食其果，因为他们过去谈论了太多关于 AI 的危险。)

[Andrew] Yes, that is true. If you tell the government at all times that your AI is very dangerous and is able to destroy the world, the government will believe you. They will make rules to stop you from sharing it.
(是的，那是真的。如果你一直告诉政府你的 AI 非常危险并且能够毁灭世界，政府就会相信你。他们会制定规则来阻止你分享它。)

[Aria] This shows that the government is taking very strong control over new science now.
(这表明政府现在正在对新科学进行非常强力的控制。)

[Andrew] Let us talk about a happier story now. It is about retirement. In the past, retirement meant playing golf and traveling.
(现在让我们谈谈一个更快乐的故事。它是关于退休的。在过去，退休意味着打高尔夫球和旅行。)

[Aria] Yes, older persons used to spend their days in the garden or walking by the sea. But now, these baby boomers are spending their time online.
(是的，老年人过去常常在花园里度过他们的日子，或者在海边散步。但现在，这些婴儿潮一代正在网上度过他们的时间。)

[Andrew] That is true. A great number of older persons are using the internet for many hours every day.
(那是真的。大量的老年人每天花很多小时使用互联网。)

[Aria] What are they doing on the internet, Andrew?
(他们在互联网上做什么，Andrew？)

[Andrew] They are playing games, watching videos, and talking to their friends and family on social media. Some are even making videos of their own and getting a great number of followers.
(他们正在玩游戏、看视频，并在社交媒体上与朋友和家人聊天。有些人甚至在制作自己的视频，并获得了大量的关注者。)

[Aria] This is a very good change. It keeps their brains active and helps them not feel alone in their houses.
(这是一个非常好的变化。这能保持他们的大脑活跃，并帮助他们不觉得在家里孤单。)

[Andrew] Yes, the internet is not only for young persons. It is a place for every person, no matter their age. It gives much amusement and learning to older persons.
(是的，互联网不仅是给年轻人的。它是一个适合每个人的地方，无论年龄大小。它给老年人带来了很多乐趣和学习。)

[Aria] Now let us look at news from China. There was robust growth in e-commerce logistics in May.
(现在让我们看看来自中国的新闻。5 月份电子商务物流实现了强劲增长。)

[Andrew] Let us make this clear for our English learners. "Logistics" means the transport and sending of goods that persons buy.
(让我们为我们的英语学习者解释清楚。“物流”是指人们购买的商品的运输和发送。)

[Aria] Yes. In May, the number of parcels sent in China went up by a great amount. This highlights the resilience of China's domestic demand.
(是的。5 月份，中国寄出的包裹数量大幅上升。这突显了中国国内需求的韧性。)

[Andrew] "Resilience" means the power to stay strong even when there are difficulties. And "domestic demand" means the desire of persons inside the country to buy things.
(Resilience（韧性）意味着即使在遇到困难时也能保持强大的力量。而 domestic demand（国内需求）是指国内人们购买物品的欲望。)

[Aria] Even though the world economy has some trouble, Chinese consumers are still buying many things online.
(尽管世界经济有一些困难，中国消费者仍然在网上购买很多东西。)

[Andrew] This growth is good for many businesses, from the makers of goods to the drivers who deliver the parcels to houses. It shows that the economic system in China is very active and strong.
(这种增长对许多企业都有好处，从商品的制造者到把包裹送到家门口的快递司机。这表明中国的经济体系非常活跃和强大。)

[Aria] Let us travel to Europe now. Switzerland had a very important vote.
(现在让我们去欧洲旅行。瑞士进行了一次非常重要的投票。)

[Andrew] The vote was about a proposal to cap the population of Switzerland at 10,000,000.
(这次投票是关于一项将瑞士人口限制在 10,000,000 人的提案。)

[Aria] "Cap" means to put a limit on something. Why did some persons want to limit the population of Switzerland?
(Cap（限制）意味着对某事设置限制。为什么有些人想要限制瑞士的人口？)

[Andrew] The right-wing group in Switzerland was worried that too many persons are moving into the country. They feared that the country would become too full, and there would not be enough houses, schools, or green space.
(瑞士的右翼团体担心有太多人搬进该国。他们担心国家会变得太拥挤，没有足够的房子、学校或绿地。)

[Aria] So they wanted to cut migration, which means stopping persons from other countries from coming to live in Switzerland.
(所以他们想要减少移民，这意味着阻止来自其他国家的人来到瑞士生活。)

[Andrew] Yes. But the projections say that the Swiss voters have voted against this proposal.
(是的。但预测显示，瑞士选民投票反对了这一提案。)

[Aria] Why did they vote against it?
(他们为什么投票反对它？)

[Andrew] Because Switzerland needs workers from other countries to keep its businesses running. If they put a limit, it would cause a big clash with the European Union.
(因为瑞士需要来自其他国家的工人来保持其业务运转。如果他们设置限制，将与欧盟产生巨大的冲突。)

[Aria] Switzerland is not in the EU, but they have many agreements with the EU for trade and free movement of persons.
(瑞士不在欧盟，但他们与欧盟在贸易和人员自由流动方面达成了许多协议。)

[Andrew] That is right. Voting against the cap avoids a big political fight and keeps the economy healthy.
(那是对的。投票反对限制避免了一场重大的政治斗争，并保持了经济健康。)

[Aria] Our next story is about a conflict on the sea. UK forces have seized a suspected Russian shadow fleet oil ship in the English Channel.
(我们的下一个故事是关于海上冲突的。英国军队在英吉利海峡扣押了一艘涉嫌属于俄罗斯影子舰队的油轮。)

[Andrew] The English Channel is the narrow sea between England and France. It is a very busy road for ships.
(英吉利海峡是英格兰和法国之间的狭窄海域。这是一条非常繁忙的船只通道。)

[Aria] What is a "shadow fleet"?
(什么是“影子舰队”？)

[Andrew] A shadow fleet is a group of old ships that carry oil for a country under sanctions. "Sanctions" are rules made by governments to stop trade with a country as a punishment.
(影子舰队是指在遭受制裁的情况下，为某个国家运送石油的一群旧船。Sanctions（制裁）是政府制定的规则，旨在停止与某个国家的贸易以作为惩罚。)

[Aria] So Russia is using these old ships to sell its oil to other countries, even though the UK and Europe have rules against it.
(因此，俄罗斯正在使用这些旧船将其石油卖给其他国家，尽管英国和欧洲有规则禁止这样做。)

[Andrew] Yes. The UK government believes this specific ship was linked to Russia and was carrying oil without proper insurance.
(是的。英国政府认为这艘特定的船只与俄罗斯有关，并且在没有适当保险的情况下运送石油。)

[Aria] That is dangerous for the environment. If an old ship has a crack, the oil will go into the sea and kill many fish and birds.
(那对环境是危险的。如果一艘旧船出现裂缝，石油就会流入大海，杀死许多鱼和鸟类。)

[Andrew] That is why British forces intercepted and detained the vessel. They want to show that they will enforce the rules strictly.
(这就是为什么英国军队拦截并扣押了这艘船。他们想表明他们将严格执行规则。)

[Aria] Finally, let us talk about the Middle East and Donald Trump.
(最后，让我们谈谈中东和 Donald Trump。)

[Andrew] Trump has claimed that a peace deal between the US and Iran will be signed this Sunday.
(Trump 声称美国和伊朗之间的和平协议将于本周日签署。)

[Aria] But Tehran, which is the capital of Iran, is signaling that there might be delays.
(但是伊朗首都德黑兰则发出信号，表明可能会有延迟。)

[Andrew] Yes, Trump is heading to the G7 meeting in France. He wants to meet with Middle East partners on the sidelines of the meeting.
(是的，Trump 正前往法国参加 G7 会议。他希望在会议期间与中东合作伙伴会面。)

[Aria] What is the G7?
(什么是 G7？)

[Andrew] The G7 is a group of 7 great countries with strong economies. They meet to talk about the problems of the world.
(G7 是由 7 个经济强大的大型国家组成的集团。他们会面讨论世界的问题。)

[Aria] Trump wants to talk about removing mines from the Strait of Hormuz. What is that strait?
(Trump 想要谈论清除霍尔木兹海峡的水雷。那个海峡是什么？)

[Andrew] The Strait of Hormuz is a very narrow water passage. A great amount of the world's oil goes through this strait. If there are mines, ships cannot pass, and the price of oil will go up very high.
(霍尔木兹海峡是一条非常狭窄的水道。世界上大量的石油都经过这个海峡。如果有水雷，船只就无法通过，石油价格就会涨得非常高。)

[Aria] That would be very bad for the world economy. Meanwhile, Qatari mediators have traveled to Tehran.
(那对世界经济将非常不利。与此同时，卡塔尔调解人已经前往德黑兰。)

[Andrew] "Mediators" are helpers who try to make two angry sides come to an agreement. Qatar is a small but rich country in the Middle East that frequently helps with peace talks.
(Mediators（调解人）是试图让愤怒的双方达成协议的帮手。卡塔尔是中东一个虽小但富裕的国家，经常协助和平谈判。)

[Aria] They are trying to put the final touches on a possible deal to end the war.
(他们正试图为一个可能结束战争的协议做最后的润色。)

[Andrew] It is a race against time. If they are able to sign the agreement, it will be a great step for peace in the world.
(这是一场与时间的赛跑。如果他们能够签署协议，那将是世界和平迈出的伟大一步。)

[Aria] This is all the news we have for this evening. We hope you have learned some new English words and got a clear picture of the world.
(这就是我们今晚的全部新闻。我们希望你学到了一些新的英语单词，并对世界有了清晰的了解。)

[Andrew] Yes, learning English with the news is a very good way to make your knowledge grow.
(是的，通过新闻学习英语是增长知识的一种非常好的方法。)

[Aria] Thank you for giving ear to our show. Have a beautiful night.
(感谢收听我们的节目。祝你度过一个美丽的夜晚。)

[Andrew] Goodbye, every person. See you tomorrow.
(再见，各位。明天见。)

item.title: 2026-06-14 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning, dear friends! Welcome to our morning news podcast. My name is Aria, and I am very happy to talk with you on this beautiful day.
(早上好，亲爱的朋友们！欢迎收听我们的早间新闻播客。我的名字是 Aria，我很高兴在这个美丽的一天与你们交谈。)

[Andrew] Good morning, Aria! And good morning to all our listeners who are getting learning of English with us today. My name is Andrew. We have a very long and detailed show for you today.
(早上好，Aria！也祝我们所有今天和我们一起学习英语的听众朋友们早上好。我的名字是 Andrew。今天我们为您准备了一期非常长且详细的节目。)

[Aria] Yes, Andrew. We have many interesting stories from the world of technology, business, and world events. We will talk about these stories using only the basic words of the English language. This will help you get the sense of the news easily.
(是的，Andrew。我们有许多来自科技、商业和世界大事的有趣故事。我们将仅使用英语中最基础的单词来讲述这些故事。这将帮助您轻松理解新闻的含义。)

[Andrew] That is our great purpose, Aria. We want to give you a clear view of the world while you make your English stronger. Let us start with our first part today, which is about technology.
(那是我们伟大的目的，Aria。我们希望在您增强英语能力的同时，为您提供一个清晰的世界观。让我们从今天的第一部分开始，那是关于科技的。)

[Aria] Our first story is about a new small machine that you wear on your arm. It is named the Fitbit Air. Some experts have given their opinion on this machine, and they say it is very interesting.
(我们的第一个故事是关于一个戴在手臂上的新小机器。它的名字叫 Fitbit Air。一些专家对这个机器发表了意见，他们说它非常有趣。)

[Andrew] Yes, Aria. The most surprising thing about the Fitbit Air is that it has no glass face. You cannot see the time or any numbers on it. It is just a simple band of material on your arm.
(是的，Aria。关于 Fitbit Air 最令人惊讶的是它没有玻璃镜面。你无法在上面看到时间或任何数字。它只是你手臂上一条简单的材料带。)

[Aria] That is very strange for a new machine. Most new machines have big, bright windows to show you numbers. Why did they make it with no glass face?
(对于一个新机器来说，这非常奇怪。大多数新机器都有大而亮的窗口来向你显示数字。他们为什么把它做成没有玻璃镜面的呢？)

[Andrew] The makers want people to have a quiet mind. When you have a window with numbers on your arm, you look at it all the time. You get worried about the numbers. With this machine, you just wear it and do not give thought to it.
(制造者希望人们拥有安静的心灵。当你的手臂上有一个显示数字的窗口时，你会一直看着它。你会为这些数字感到担心。有了这个机器，你只需戴着它，不用去想它。)

[Aria] I see. But how do you see your records? How do you have knowledge of how much you walked or how you slept?
(我明白了。但是你如何查看你的记录呢？你如何知道你走了多少路或者睡得怎么样？)

[Andrew] You have to use your phone. The small machine sends the records to your phone. Then you can see everything on the phone. Some people say they stopped using their big Pixel Watch because they like this simple band more.
(你必须使用你的手机。这个小机器把记录发送到你的手机上。然后你就可以在手机上看到一切。有些人说他们停止使用他们的大 Pixel Watch，因为他们更喜欢这条简单的手带。)

[Aria] But there is another machine like this, named the Whoop. How is the Fitbit Air different from the Whoop?
(但是还有另一个像这样的机器，名叫 Whoop。Fitbit Air 和 Whoop 有什么不同？)

[Andrew] The Whoop is also a band with no glass face. But the Fitbit Air has a new guide. This guide is a machine that talks to you. It uses a new brain to give you suggestions. For example, it can say, "You did not sleep well last night. You should take a rest today."
(Whoop 也是一条没有玻璃镜面的手带。但是 Fitbit Air 有一个新向导。这个向导是一个会和你说话的机器。它使用一个新大脑来给你建议。例如，它会说：“你昨晚没睡好。你今天应该休息一下。”)

[Aria] That seems very helpful. But some people say this talking guide is too loud and talks too much! They get tired of its suggestions.
(这似乎很有帮助。但是有些人说这个会说话的向导太吵了，话太多了！他们对它的建议感到厌烦。)

[Andrew] Yes, that is a problem. Sometimes the guide gives too many suggestions when you just want to be quiet. But it is still a very beautiful and light machine.
(是的，那是一个问题。有时当你只想安静的时候，向导会给出太多的建议。但它仍然是一个非常美丽且轻巧的机器。)

[Aria] It is interesting to see how these small machines are changing. Now let us talk about Apple. Apple is a very big company that makes phones and computers. They have made a new decision to stop support for sixteen of their old machines.
(看到这些小机器的变化真是有趣。现在让我们来谈谈 Apple。Apple 是一间制造手机和电脑的非常大的公司。他们做出了一个新决定，停止对他们十六款旧机器的支持。)

[Andrew] This is important news for many people. If you have an old iPhone, iPad, or Mac computer, you might not get new changes this fall.
(这对许多人来说是重要的新闻。如果你有一部旧的 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 电脑，你今年秋天可能就无法获得新的变化了。)

[Aria] Why does Apple do this? Why do they stop supporting old machines?
(Apple 为什么要这样做？他们为什么要停止支持旧机器？)

[Andrew] They say the old machines do not have enough power for the new software. The new software needs a very strong brain. The old machines are too slow and feeble.
(他们说旧机器没有足够的动力来运行新软件。新软件需要一个非常强大的大脑。旧机器太慢且太弱了。)

[Aria] But this makes some people angry. They paid a lot of money for their machines, and now they have to get new ones if they want the new changes.
(但这也让一些人感到愤怒。他们为自己的机器付了很多钱，现在如果他们想要新的变化，就必须买新的。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is a danger for Apple. If people feel that their machines get old too quickly, they might get angry and stop buying Apple things. But Apple says it is necessary for development. They want to make the future better with stronger machines.
(是的，这对 Apple 来说是一个危险。如果人们觉得他们的机器老化得太快，他们可能会感到愤怒并停止购买 Apple 的东西。但 Apple 表示，这对于发展是必要的。他们希望用更强大的机器让未来变得更好。)

[Aria] Our third story is about a very popular play on the computer, named Destiny 2. The company Bungie has made the last change to this play.
(我们的第三个故事是关于电脑上一款非常受欢迎的游戏，名叫 Destiny 2。Bungie 公司对这款游戏进行了最后的修改。)

[Andrew] This is a sweet and sad moment for many play persons. Destiny 2 has been a very big part of their lives for many years. Now, the last change is here.
(对于许多游戏玩家来说，这是一个甜蜜而悲伤的时刻。多年来，Destiny 2 一直是他们生活中非常重要的一部分。现在，最后的改变来了。)

[Aria] But the news says that a very great number of people went to play it after the change came out. It had the highest number of play persons in two years!
(但新闻说，在这个改变推出后，有非常多的人去玩它。它拥有两年来最高的游戏人数！)

[Andrew] That is true. People wanted to see the end of the story. Bungie also gave free gifts to the players, like beautiful ornaments for their play bodies.
(那是真的。人们想看看故事的结局。Bungie 还给玩家们送了免费的礼物，比如给他们游戏角色的美丽装饰品。)

[Aria] It is good that the play ends with a great win. Even though it is sad that there will be no more new changes, the play persons are very happy with this last part.
(游戏以伟大的胜利结束是件好事。尽管不会再有新的改变令人难过，但游戏玩家们对这最后一部分感到非常高兴。)

[Andrew] Yes, it shows that a good story can keep people interested for a very long time. It is like a good book that you do not want to put down.
(是的，这表明一个好故事可以让人们在很长一段时间内保持兴趣。它就像一本你不想放下的好书。)

[Aria] Our last technology story is about a new game of Tomb Raider, named Legacy of Atlantis. The new star who plays Lara Croft has talked about her way of acting.
(我们最后一个科技故事是关于 Tomb Raider 的一款新游戏，名叫 Legacy of Atlantis。扮演 Lara Croft 的新明星谈到了她的表演方式。)

[Andrew] Lara Croft is a very famous woman in games. She goes to old places to find secret things. The new star says she wants to play Lara Croft in a classic and strong way, with no regret.
(Lara Croft 是游戏里一位非常著名的女性。她去古老的地方寻找秘密的东西。这位新明星说，她想以一种经典且强大、不留遗憾的方式来扮演 Lara Croft。)

[Aria] Yes, she wants to make Lara Croft seem like the old Lara Croft we had in the past, but with new and beautiful pictures. People who have played the new game say it is very fast and exciting.
(是的，她想让 Lara Croft 看起来像我们过去的那个经典的 Lara Croft，但配有全新且美丽的画面。玩过这款新游戏的人说它非常快速且令人兴奋。)

[Andrew] You can pay for the game before it comes out now. Many people are ready to do this because they love the old stories of Lara Croft.
(你现在可以在游戏推出前付款预订。许多人已经准备好这样做，因为他们热爱 Lara Croft 的古老故事。)

[Aria] It is wonderful that old stories can be made new again for young people. Now, let us move to our second part, which is about business and money.
(能让古老的故事为年轻人重新焕发生机真是太棒了。现在，让我们进入第二部分，那是关于商业和金钱的。)

[Andrew] Our first business story is about Amazon and a company named Anthropic. Anthropic makes very big thinking machines.
(我们的第一个商业故事是关于 Amazon 和一间名叫 Anthropic 的公司。Anthropic 制造非常大型的思考机器。)

[Aria] Yes, Andrew. The government of the United States has put strong controls on the new thinking machines made by Anthropic. But the news says that Amazon had fears about these machines before the government acted.
(是的，Andrew。美国政府对 Anthropic 制造的新型思考机器实施了严格的控制。但新闻说，在政府采取行动之前，Amazon 就对这些机器感到担忧。)

[Andrew] Why did Amazon have fears? Amazon is a partner of Anthropic and has given them a lot of money.
(Amazon 为什么会感到担忧？Amazon 是 Anthropic 的合作伙伴，并给了他们很多钱。)

[Aria] Amazon was worried that the new thinking machines were too strong and could cause danger. The chief of Amazon had talks with government officials about this.
(Amazon 担心新的思考机器太强大，可能会带来危险。Amazon 的负责人就此与政府官员进行了会谈。)

[Andrew] That is very interesting. After those talks, the government made a quick decision to stop Anthropic from letting other countries use their new machine, named Mythos.
(那非常有趣。在那些会谈之后，政府迅速做出决定，阻止 Anthropic 让其他国家使用他们名为 Mythos 的新机器。)

[Aria] Yes, Anthropic had to shut down access to Mythos very quickly. This shows that even big companies are afraid of how fast these thinking machines are growing.
(是的，Anthropic 必须非常迅速地关闭对 Mythos 的访问。这表明，即使是大公司也对这些思考机器的发展速度感到害怕。)

[Andrew] It is a very complex situation. We want to have better technology, but we also need to be safe from its power.
(这是一个非常复杂的情况。我们希望拥有更好的技术，但我们也需要安全地应对它的力量。)

[Aria] Our next story is about SpaceX, the company that makes rockets to go to the stars. They had their first public sale of stock, which is called an IPO.
(我们的下一个故事是关于 SpaceX，这间制造去往星空的火箭的公司。他们进行了首次股票公开发售，这被称为 IPO。)

[Andrew] This was the largest public sale of stock ever! Many people were worried that it would cause trouble for the stock market, but the market survived very well.
(这是有史以来最大规模的股票公开发售！许多人担心这会给股市带来麻烦，但市场很好地幸存了下来。)

[Aria] And the stock of SpaceX went up by nearly thirty percent! That is a very big increase in a short time.
(而且 SpaceX 的股票上涨了将近百分之三十！这在短时间内是一个非常大的增长。)

[Andrew] Because of this, Elon Musk, the owner of SpaceX, has become the first trillionaire on earth. A trillionaire is a man who has a million million dollars!
(正因为如此，SpaceX 的所有者 Elon Musk 成为了地球上的第一个万亿富翁。万亿富翁是指拥有万亿美金的人！)

[Aria] That is an amount of money that is hard to have thoughts about. It is more money than some countries have!
(那是一个很难想象的资金数额。这比一些国家拥有的钱还要多！)

[Andrew] Yes, and some experts from Goldman say that other big technology stocks, like Nvidia, still have room to get bigger. The market is very strong right now.
(是的，高盛的一些专家表示，其他大型科技股，如 Nvidia，仍有变大的空间。现在的市场非常强劲。)

[Aria] It seems that the desire for space and new technology is making some people very rich. Now we have news about two very big movie companies, Paramount and Warner Bros.
(看来对太空和新技术的渴望正在让一些人变得非常富有。现在我们有关于两间非常大的电影公司 Paramount 和 Warner Bros 的新闻。)

[Andrew] The government's Justice Department has given approval for Paramount to buy Warner Bros. This is a very big change for the movie business.
(政府司法部已批准 Paramount 收购 Warner Bros。这对电影业来说是一个非常大的变化。)

[Aria] These two companies make many of the films and television shows that we watch. Now they will become one giant company.
(这两间公司制作了我们观看的许多电影和电视节目。现在它们将合并为一间巨型公司。)

[Andrew] Some people are worried that this joining will make competition less. If there is only one big company, they can make the price of tickets and television services higher.
(有些人担心这种合并会减少竞争。如果只有一间大公司，他们可以把门票和电视服务的价格定得更高。)

[Aria] That is a true danger. But the companies say they need to join together to fight against other big streaming services. The government has cleared the way, so we will see how this changes the films we see in the future.
(那是一个真正的危险。但这些公司表示，他们需要联合起来对抗其他大型流媒体服务。政府已经扫清了道路，所以我们将看看这会如何改变我们未来看到的电影。)

[Andrew] Yes, we hope that they will still make beautiful and interesting films for us, and not just look for profit.
(是的，我们希望他们仍然会为我们制作美丽而有趣的电影，而不仅仅是追求利润。)

[Aria] Our last business story is about OpenAI, the company that makes ChatGPT. A group of state law chiefs is looking into the company.
(我们最后一个商业故事是关于 OpenAI，这间制作 ChatGPT 的公司。一组州法律负责人正在对该公司进行调查。)

[Andrew] Yes, they are making a search into how ChatGPT might cause damage to young users. They are worried about the effect of these thinking machines on the minds of children.
(是的，他们正在调查 ChatGPT 可能会对年轻用户造成什么伤害。他们担心这些思考机器对儿童心灵的影响。)

[Aria] OpenAI has said that they are committed to learning and making their machines safe. But this search comes at a bad time for them, because they are planning to have their first public sale of stock soon.
(OpenAI 表示，他们致力于学习并确保机器的安全。但这次调查对他们来说来得不是时候，因为他们计划很快进行首次股票公开发售。)

[Andrew] Yes, if the law chiefs find that OpenAI has caused harm, it could make the value of the company go down. It is a very serious situation for them.
(是的，如果法律负责人发现 OpenAI 造成了伤害，这可能会导致公司的价值下降。这对他们来说是一个非常严重的情况。)

[Aria] It is important to protect young minds from bad influences. Now let us turn to our third part, which is about the world and conflicts.
(保护年轻的心灵免受不良影响是很重要的。现在让我们转向第三部分，那是关于世界与冲突的。)

[Andrew] Our first story is from the war between Ukraine and Russia. Ukraine has made a flying machine attack on southern Russia.
(我们的第一个故事来自乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的战争。乌克兰对俄罗斯南部发动了飞行器袭击。)

[Aria] This attack took the life of one person and made three people wounded. The attack also caused a big fire at a sea station.
(这次袭击夺走了一个人的生命，并造成三人受伤。袭击还引起了海上站点的火灾。)

[Andrew] Ukraine says they will keep targeting Russian oil and power structures to stop their war machine. They even hit a military plant deep inside Russia.
(乌克兰表示，他们将继续针对俄罗斯的石油和电力设施，以阻止他们的战争机器。他们甚至袭击了俄罗斯深处的一间军工厂。)

[Aria] Russia has tried to protect their buildings by wrapping them in nets of iron, but Ukraine used flying bombs to break through. It is a very violent and sad war that does not seem to end.
(俄罗斯试图通过用铁网包裹建筑物来保护它们，但乌克兰使用飞行炸弹突破了防线。这是一场非常暴力且悲伤的战争，似乎没有尽头。)

[Andrew] We hope that peace will come soon to those lands. Our next story is about political leaders. Donald Trump and Emmanuel Macron will meet for dinner at the great Versailles palace in France.
(我们希望和平能尽快降临到那些土地上。我们的下一个故事是关于政治领袖的。Donald Trump 和 Emmanuel Macron 将在法国伟大的凡尔赛宫共进晚餐。)

[Aria] This meeting will happen after the G7 meeting of chiefs in France. Macron has had a special way of managing Trump in the past, and this dinner will test his art.
(这次会面将在法国举行的 G7 首脑会议之后进行。Macron 过去在应对 Trump 方面有其独特的方法，而这次晚宴将考验他的艺术。)

[Andrew] Trump will also meet with leaders from the Mideast and attend a session about Ukraine. This is a very important time for world relations, as many countries are waiting to see what Trump's plans are.
(Trump 还将与来自中东的领导人会面，并参加关于乌克兰的会议。这是世界关系中一个非常重要的时刻，因为许多国家都在等待看 Trump 的计划是什么。)

[Aria] Yes, the dinner at the beautiful palace of Versailles will be a place for quiet talks before big decisions are made. It is a very beautiful place with a long history.
(是的，在美丽的凡尔赛宫举行的晚宴将是做出重大决定前进行安静谈话的场所。那是一个有着悠久历史的非常美丽的地方。)

[Andrew] Now we go to Switzerland. The Swiss people will vote on a plan to limit their number of people to ten million.
(现在我们去瑞士。瑞士人民将对一项将人口数量限制在 1000 万以内的计划进行投票。)

[Aria] Switzerland is a beautiful country with many mountains. But some people there are worried that too many people are coming to live there. They feel the country is getting too full.
(瑞士是一个拥有许多美丽大山的国家。但那里的有些人担心有太多的人来这里居住。他们觉得国家变得太拥挤了。)

[Andrew] If the voters say yes to this plan, the government will have to take steps to stop more people from coming in. This could make relations with other European countries difficult.
(如果选民对这个计划说“是”，政府将不得不采取措施阻止更多的人进入。这可能会使与其他欧洲国家的关系变得困难。)

[Aria] Yes, because many people come from other countries to work in Switzerland. We will have to wait and see what the Swiss voters decide on their voting papers.
(是的，因为许多人从其他国家来到瑞士工作。我们将不得不等待，看看瑞士选民在选票上做出什么决定。)

[Andrew] Our last story is about Mark Carney, a leader from Canada. He has called for Canada and the European Union to stand together before the G7 meeting.
(我们的最后一个故事是关于来自加拿大的领导人 Mark Carney。他呼吁加拿大和欧盟在 G7 会议前站在一起。)

[Aria] Carney says there is a danger of a global split in trade. He says that middle countries should not just try to get the help and good opinion of the United States.
(Carney 表示，全球贸易存在分裂的危险。他说，中等国家不应该只是试图获得美国的帮助和好感。)

[Andrew] Instead, they should work together to make their own trade strong. He softened his voice toward Trump because of the trade talks that are coming, but his message is clear: countries must be strong together.
(相反，他们应该共同努力，使自己的贸易强劲。由于即将进行的贸易谈判，他对 Trump 缓和了语气，但他的信息很明确：各国必须共同强大。)

[Aria] That is a very wise thought. In a world with many changes, working together is the best way to keep safe.
(那是一个非常明智的想法。在一个充满变化的世界里，共同努力是保持安全的最好方法。)

[Andrew] Yes, Aria. We have covered many stories today. It is clear that the world is moving very fast, and we need to keep learning to understand it.
(是的，Aria。我们今天报道了许多故事。很明显，世界正在非常快速地发展，我们需要不断学习来理解它。)

[Aria] That is true, Andrew. And for our listeners, learning English is a great way to open new doors to the world.
(那是真的，Andrew。对于我们的听众来说，学习英语是向世界打开新大门的绝佳方式。)

[Andrew] We hope you enjoyed our podcast today. We will be back tomorrow with more news and more English learning.
(我们希望您喜欢我们今天的播客。我们明天会回来，带来更多的新闻和更多的英语学习。)

[Aria] Thank you for listening, friends! Have a beautiful and happy day!
(谢谢收听，朋友们！祝您度过美丽而快乐的一天！)

[Andrew] Goodbye, everyone!
(大家再见！)

item.title: 2026-06-15 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good evening. Welcome to our news talk. I am Aria.
(晚上好。欢迎收听我们的新闻访谈。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We are happy to be with you this night to talk about the news of the earth.
(我是 Andrew。我们很高兴今晚能和大家在一起，聊聊地球上的新闻。)

[Aria] We have much news this night. We will talk about new machines, the money market, and agreements between nations.
(今晚我们有很多新闻。我们将谈论新机器、货币市场以及国家之间的协定。)

[Andrew] Yes, and we will use simple words so that you can get good learning of the English language while you get the news.
(是的，我们将使用简单的词汇，以便您在获取新闻的同时，能很好地学习英语。)

[Aria] We will make sure that every word we use is from a list of eight hundred and fifty basic words. This will help you get a clear picture of the stories.
(我们将确保我们使用的每个单词都来自八百五十个基础单词的列表。这将帮助您对这些故事有一个清晰的了解。)

[Andrew] That is right. We will not use complex words. If we have to use a special name, we will explain it with simple words.
(没有错。我们不会使用复杂的词汇。如果我们必须使用一个特殊的名字，我们会用简单的词汇来解释它。)

[Aria] Let us start with our first story. It is about a new talking machine. It is named the Trump Phone.
(让我们从我们的第一个故事开始。它关于一款新的通话机器。它被命名为 Trump Phone。)

[Andrew] This is a very interesting story. Some persons said this machine was made in America. They said it was a special machine for the supporters of Trump.
(这是一个非常有趣的故事。有人说这台机器是在美国制造的。他们说这是给 Trump 支持者的一台特殊机器。)

[Aria] But some experts who have much knowledge of machines took this machine apart. They wanted to see the inside of the machine.
(但是一些对机器有丰富知识的专家把这台机器拆开了。他们想看看机器的内部。)

[Andrew] Yes, they wanted to see if the statement about the machine was true. And they made a great discovery.
(是的，他们想看看关于这台机器的说法是否真实。然后他们有了一个重大的发现。)

[Aria] What was the discovery, Andrew?
(这个发现是什么，Andrew？)

[Andrew] They saw that the inside of this machine is almost the same as a machine made by HTC. HTC is a company from Taiwan.
(他们发现这台机器的内部与 HTC 制造的机器几乎一模一样。HTC 是一来自台湾的公司。)

[Aria] So, the machine was not designed or made in America?
(所以，这台机器不是在美国设计或制造的？)

[Andrew] No, it was not. In fact, the parts inside the machine are from China. The machine is just an HTC machine with a different name on the outside.
(不，它不是。事实上，机器内部的零件来自中国。这台机器只是一台在外壳上印了不同名字的 HTC 机器。)

[Aria] That is a very big surprise for the persons who gave their money for it. They made a payment of much money because they had belief in the name of Trump.
(对于那些为此付了钱的人来说，这是一个非常大的意外。他们支付了大量的钱，因为他们信任 Trump 的名字。)

[Andrew] Yes, they made a payment of several hundred dollars. They had the thought that they were supporting American work and American industry.
(是的，他们支付了几百美元。他们认为自己是在支持美国的工作和美国的工业。)

[Aria] But in fact, their money went to a machine that was made across the sea. This is like a bad trick.
(但事实上，他们的钱买了一台在海外制造的机器。这就像一个恶劣的把戏。)

[Andrew] It is a hidden form. In the news, some writers say it is a false offer. It makes persons feel sad and angry.
(它是一种隐藏的形式。在新闻中，一些作者说这是一个虚假的报价。它让人们感到悲伤和愤怒。)

[Aria] Why did the company do this?
(公司为什么要这样做？)

[Andrew] The purpose was to make a quick profit. They knew that the name of Trump is very powerful. Many persons will get anything with his name on it.
(目的是为了快速获利。他们知道 Trump 的名字非常强大。许多人会购买任何印有他名字的东西。)

[Aria] So they took a cheap machine from Taiwan, put a new cover on it, and offered it for a very high price.
(所以他们从台湾拿了一台便宜的机器，给它换了一个新外壳，然后以非常高的价格出售。)

[Andrew] Yes, that is the story. It shows that we must be very careful when we see advertisements. We must not have belief in every statement we read.
(是的，这就是故事的经过。它表明我们在看到广告时必须非常小心。我们绝不能相信我们读到的每一个声明。)

[Aria] That is a very good lesson for all of us. Now, let us talk about another talking machine company. This is Apple.
(这对我们所有人来说都是一个很好的教训。现在，让我们谈谈另一家通话机器公司。这就是 Apple。)

[Andrew] Apple has a new system for their machines. It is named iOS 27.
(Apple 为他们的机器配备了一个新系统。它被命名为 iOS 27。)

[Aria] This new system is very interesting because it helps older machines. It makes them run more quickly and keep their power longer.
(这个新系统非常有趣，因为它对旧机器有帮助。它使它们运行得更快，并保持更长时间的电力。)

[Andrew] Yes, the power box of a talking machine frequently becomes weak after some years. This is a common trouble for all of us.
(是的，通话机器的电源箱在几年后经常会变弱。这对我们所有人来说都是一个常见的问题。)

[Aria] When the power box is weak, the machine becomes slow. Sometimes it even shuts down when we are using it.
(当电源箱变弱时，机器就会变慢。有时它甚至会在我们使用它时关机。)

[Andrew] But with iOS 27, Apple has made adjustments to the system. It has a better Low Power Mode.
(但通过 iOS 27，Apple 对系统进行了调整。它有一个更好的低电量模式。)

[Aria] How does this Low Power Mode work, Andrew?
(这个低电量模式是如何工作的，Andrew？)

[Andrew] It makes the machine use less electric power when the power box is low. It stops some parts of the system that are not necessary.
(这种模式在电源箱电量低时使机器使用更少的电能。它会停止系统的一些不必要的部​​分。)

[Aria] For example, it may make the light of the screen less bright, or it may stop the machine from looking for new mails when you are not watching.
(例如，它可能会使屏幕的光线变暗，或者在您不看的时候停止机器寻找新邮件。)

[Andrew] Yes, and it also makes the brain of the machine work in a more simple way. This keeps the machine cool and makes the power last for a longer time.
(是的，它还使机器的大脑以更简单的方式工作。这可以保持机器冷却，并使电力持续更长时间。)

[Aria] This is a very good development. In the past, some persons had the thought that Apple made older machines slow on purpose.
(这是一个非常好的发展。在过去，有些人认为 Apple 是故意让旧机器变慢的。)

[Andrew] Yes, they had the thought that Apple wanted them to get a new machine. But now, this new system shows that Apple wants to help persons keep their old machines.
(是的，他们认为 Apple 想让他们买一台新机器。但现在，这个新系统表明 Apple 想帮助人们保留他们的旧机器。)

[Aria] This is good for our pockets because we do not have to give money for a new machine every year.
(这对我们的钱包有好处，因为我们不必每年都为新机器付钱。)

[Andrew] And it is good for the earth as well. When we keep our machines longer, we make less waste. The destruction of the environment is a serious question, so this is a good step.
(而且这对地球也有好处。当我们把机器保留得更久时，我们产生的垃圾就会减少。环境的破坏是一个严重的问题，所以这是一个很好的步骤。)

[Aria] I agree. It is good to see a company making things better for older machines, not only for the new ones.
(我同意。很高兴看到一家公司为旧机器而不仅仅是新机器把事情做得更好。)

[Andrew] Let us move to our third story. It is about the play industry. Microsoft is a very great company, and they have a play system named Xbox.
(让我们转向我们的第三个故事。它是关于游戏行业的。Microsoft 是一家非常伟大的公司，他们有一个名为 Xbox 的游戏系统。)

[Aria] But there is news that Microsoft is thinking about making Xbox a separate company.
(但有新闻称，Microsoft 正在考虑将 Xbox 变成一家独立的公司。)

[Andrew] Why would they do this, Aria? Xbox is a very famous name in the play world.
(他们为什么要这样做，Aria？Xbox 在游戏界是一个非常著名的名字。)

[Aria] The reason is that they have had some troubles. They have not made as much profit as they wanted.
(原因在于他们遇到了一些麻烦。他们没有获得他们想要的那么多利润。)

[Andrew] Yes, they had a system named Game Pass. It let persons play many games for a small payment every month. But this did not make enough money.
(是的，他们有一个名为 Game Pass 的系统。它让人们每月只需支付很少的费用就可以玩很多游戏。但这并没有赚到足够的钱。)

[Aria] In addition, they had to let many workers go. This is a very sad event for the families of those workers.
(此外，他们不得不让许多工人离开。对于那些工人的家庭来说，这是一个非常悲伤的事件。)

[Andrew] The new chief of Xbox has plans to make changes. They want to make new plays with famous names like Halo and Fallout.
(Xbox 的新负责人计划做出改变。他们想用 Halo 和 Fallout 等著名名字制作新游戏。)

[Aria] If they make Xbox a separate company, it may be able to move more quickly and make better decisions.
(如果他们将 Xbox 变成一家独立的公司，它可能会运行得更快，并做出更好的决定。)

[Andrew] But it is a big risk. The competition with other play companies, like Sony, is very strong.
(但这是一个很大的风险。与其他游戏公司（如 Sony）的竞争非常激烈。)

[Aria] We will have to watch what they do in the next hundred days. It will be a very important time for Xbox.
(我们将不得不关注他们在未来一百天内的所作所为。对于 Xbox 来说，这将是一个非常重要的时刻。)

[Andrew] Yes, the play industry is changing very fast. Many persons now play on their pocket machines or on the net, not on a big box connected to the television.
(是的，游戏行业变化非常快。现在许多人在他们的口袋机器上或网络上玩游戏，而不是在连接到电视的大盒子上玩。)

[Aria] So Microsoft must find a new way to make Xbox successful in this new condition.
(所以 Microsoft 必须找到一种新方法，让 Xbox 在这种新状况下取得成功。)

[Andrew] Now, let us talk about a new folding machine from China. It is the Honor Magic V6.
(现在，让我们谈谈一款来自中国的新型折叠机器。它是 Honor Magic V6。)

[Aria] This machine is very special. It is a folding machine, which means you can bend the screen to make it small, or open it to make it great like a book.
(这台机器非常特别。它是一台折叠机器，这意味着你可以弯曲屏幕使它变小，或者打开它使它像书一样大。)

[Andrew] Yes, and it has set three firsts in the world of folding machines.
(是的，它在折叠机器领域创造了三个第一。)

[Aria] What are these three firsts?
(这三个第一是什么？)

[Andrew] First, it is very thin and light. Second, it has a very strong structure that can even pull a plane! Third, it has a very long life for its power box.
(第一，它非常薄且轻。第二，它有一个非常强大的结构，甚至可以拉动飞机！第三，它的电源箱寿命非常长。)

[Aria] That is amazing! Pulling a plane with a folding machine? How is that possible?
(那太令人惊奇了！用折叠机器拉飞机？这怎么可能？)

[Andrew] They used the strong metal parts of the machine to connect a line to a plane, and they pulled it. This was to show how strong the structure is.
(他们利用机器坚固的金属部件将一根线连接到飞机上，然后拉动它。这是为了展示结构有多么强大。)

[Aria] This is a very good advertisement. It makes persons feel that the machine will not break easily.
(这是一个非常好的广告。它让人们觉得机器不会轻易损坏。)

[Andrew] Yes, because many persons are afraid that folding machines will break at the middle line where they bend.
(是的，因为许多人担心折叠机器会在它们弯曲的中心线处断裂。)

[Aria] In addition, Honor said they will give seven years of system changes for this machine.
(此外，Honor 表示他们将为这台机器提供七年的系统更新。)

[Andrew] That is a very long time. It means the machine will be useful for many years. It is a good direction for the industry.
(那是非常长的时间。这意味着这台机器将可以使用很多年。这是该行业的一个好方向。)

[Aria] Yes, it helps to stop waste, just like the Apple system we talked about.
(是的，它有助于减少浪费，就像我们谈到的 Apple 系统一样。)

[Andrew] Now, let us turn to the news of money and trade. The Dow, which is the list of the greatest companies on the American stock market, went up by seven hundred points!
(现在让我们转向资金和贸易的新闻。道琼斯指数，即美国股市最大公司的名单，上涨了七百点！)

[Aria] This is a record high! The market went up very quickly after Trump signed a paper about an agreement with Iran.
(这是历史新高！在 Trump 签署了一份关于与伊朗达成协定的文件后，市场迅速上涨。)

[Andrew] This agreement is a very big event. It has made the price of oil go down very quickly.
(这个协定是一个非常重大的事件。它使石油价格迅速下跌。)

[Aria] Yes, oil is very important for the industry of the earth. When the price of oil is low, the cost of making and transporting things goes down.
(是的，石油对地球的工业非常重要。当石油价格低时，制造和运输东西的成本就会下降。)

[Andrew] Trump said that oil prices will drop like a stone. But some experts say it may be more like a feather, going down slowly.
(Trump 说石油价格会像石头一样掉下来。但一些专家表示，它可能更像一片羽毛，慢慢地落下来。)

[Aria] Why do they say that?
(他们为什么要那样说？)

[Aria] Because it takes some months for the oil and gas from Iran to come back to the market in a normal way.
(因为伊朗的石油和天然气需要几个月的时间才能以正常的方式回到市场。)

[Andrew] That makes sense. But the news of the agreement alone was enough to make the stock market very happy.
(那是有道理的。但仅凭协定的消息就足以让股市非常高兴。)

[Aria] Yes, when there is peace or a good agreement between great nations, there is less fear in the market. And when there is less fear, persons are more ready to put their money into businesses.
(是的，当大国之间有和平或良好的协定时，市场上的恐惧就会减少。而当恐惧减少时，人们更愿意把钱投入到企业中。)

[Andrew] This is a very clear example of how political events have a direct effect on our daily lives and our money.
(这是一个非常清晰的例子，说明政治事件如何对我们的日常生活和我们的资金产生直接影响。)

[Aria] Let us talk about another big business event. Fox, the great television company, is getting Roku for twenty-two billion dollars!
(让我们谈谈另一个重大的商业事件。伟大的电视公司 Fox 正以二百二十亿美元的价格收购 Roku！)

[Andrew] Twenty-two billion dollars is a very great amount of money! Roku is a company that makes systems for watching television through the world net.
(二百二十亿美元是一笔非常巨大的资金！Roku 是一家制造通过世界网络收看电视系统的公司。)

[Aria] Yes, but after the news of this agreement, the stock of Fox went down.
(是的，但在这一协定的消息传出后，Fox 的股票下跌了。)

[Andrew] Why did the stock go down if they are getting a great company?
(如果他们正在收购一家伟大的公司，为什么股票会下跌？)

[Aria] Many persons who own shares in Fox think that the price of twenty-two billion dollars is too high. They fear that Fox is giving too much money.
(许多持有 Fox 股份的人认为，二百二十亿美元的价格太高了。他们担心 Fox 给的钱太多了。)

[Andrew] I see. They are fighting for the living room. Traditional television is losing viewers, and everyone wants to control the net television system.
(我明白了。他们正在争夺客厅。传统电视正在失去观众，每个人都想控制网络电视系统。)

[Aria] Yes, Roku has many users. If Fox owns Roku, they can show their news and plays directly to millions of homes without other helpers.
(是的，Roku 有很多用户。如果 Fox 拥有 Roku，他们可以直接向数百万家庭展示他们的新闻和戏剧，而不需要其他助手。)

[Andrew] But it is a very hard fight. There are other great companies like Netflix and Amazon.
(但这是一场非常艰难的战斗。还有其他伟大的公司，如 Netflix 和 Amazon。)

[Aria] So, the owners of Fox stock are not sure if this is a wise decision. They are waiting to see if this great payment will bring back a good profit.
(因此，Fox 股票的所有者不确定这是否是一个明智的决定。他们正在等待，看看这笔巨大的付款是否会带来丰厚的利润。)

[Andrew] Now, let us talk about the man who controls the money system of America. His name is Kevin Warsh.
(现在，让我们谈谈控制美国货币体系的人。他的名字叫 Kevin Warsh。)

[Aria] He is the new chief of the Federal Reserve, which we call the Fed. He is having his first big meeting and press conference.
(他是联邦储备委员会（我们称之为美联储）的新任主席。他正在举行他的第一次大型会议和新闻发布会。)

[Andrew] Everyone is watching him. They want to know his strategy for the price of things and the rate of interest.
(每个人都在看着他。他们想知道他对物价和利率的策略。)

[Aria] The rate of interest is very important. If the rate is high, it is hard for persons to get money from banks to buy houses or start businesses.
(利率非常重要。如果利率高，人们很难从银行获得资金来买房或创业。)

[Andrew] Yes, and Kevin Warsh has said in the past that he wants the Fed to stop explaining everything to the public. He wants to keep some decisions quiet.
(是的，Kevin Warsh 过去曾表示，他希望美联储停止向公众解释一切。他想让一些决定保持安静。)

[Aria] This is a very different way of doing things. The past chiefs of the Fed talked a lot to the public to make them feel safe.
(这是一种非常不同的做事方式。美联储前几任主席向公众说了很多话，让他们感到安全。)

[Andrew] Some experts think that Kevin Warsh will keep the rates the same for now. But his first meeting could bring some news that Trump does not like.
(一些专家认为 Kevin Warsh 目前将保持利率不变。但他的第一次会议可能会带来一些 Trump 不喜欢的消息。)

[Aria] Yes, because Trump wants low rates to make the market go up. But the Fed must be independent. It must do what is best for the long-term health of the money system.
(是的，因为 Trump 想要低利率来让市场上涨。但美联储必须是独立的。它必须做对货币体系长期健康最有利的事情。)

[Andrew] This will be a very interesting test of his authority and his relation with the government.
(这将是对他的权威以及他与政府关系的一次非常有趣的测试。)

[Aria] Let us talk about a fight in Silicon Valley. It is about AI, which is the system of machines that can think like humans.
(让我们谈谈硅谷的一场争斗。它是关于 AI 的，这是一种可以像人类一样思考的机器系统。)

[Andrew] There is a company named Anthropic. They make a very great AI system named Mythos.
(有一家名为 Anthropic 的公司。他们制造了一个非常伟大的 AI 系统，名为 Mythos。)

[Aria] But the White House gave them a ninety-minute deadline. They had to stop their system or make big changes because of safety fears.
(但白宫给他们留了九十分钟的截止时间。由于安全担忧，他们必须停止系统或做出重大改变。)

[Andrew] Ninety minutes! That is a very short time for a big decision.
(九十分钟！对于一个重大决定来说，这是一个非常短的时间。)

[Aria] Yes, it caused a very big fight. Some persons in the government say that these AI systems are dangerous. They fear that they can be used for bad purposes.
(是的，这引起了一场非常大的争斗。政府中的一些人说这些 AI 系统是危险的。他们担心它们会被用于不良目的。)

[Andrew] But the leaders of Anthropic were very angry. They said, "They screwed us." This means they felt they were treated in a very bad and unfair way.
(但 Anthropic 的领导人非常生气。他们说，“他们把我们搞砸了。”这意味着他们觉得受到了非常糟糕和不公平的对待。)

[Aria] Some experts say that stopping Anthropic is a gift to China.
(一些专家表示，阻止 Anthropic 是送给中国的一份礼物。)

[Andrew] Why is that?
(那是为什么？)

[Aria] Because if American companies are stopped from making better AI, then other nations like China will become the leaders in this new technology.
(因为如果美国公司被阻止制造更好的 AI，那么像中国这样的其他国家将成为这项新技术的领导者。)

[Andrew] That is a very serious point. The competition for AI is like a war without guns. It is a war of minds and machines.
(那是一个非常严肃的观点。AI 的竞争就像一场没有枪支的战争。这是一场思想和机器的战争。)

[Aria] Anthropic is going to meet with the Trump administration to talk about this dispute. We hope they can find a good agreement.
(Anthropic 将与 Trump 政府会面，讨论这一争议。We hope they can find a good agreement。)

[Andrew] Now, let us look at the news from China. There is a massive boom in domestic travel.
(现在，让我们看看来自中国的新闻。国内旅游出现了巨大的繁荣。)

[Aria] Yes, millions of Chinese persons are traveling inside their own country. They are going to famous mountains, rivers, and old towns.
(是的，数百万中国人正在自己的国家旅行。他们正在去著名的山脉、河流和古镇。)

[Andrew] This is very good for the local businesses. It brings much money to hotels, food shops, and transport systems.
(这对当地企业非常有利。它给酒店、食品店和运输系统带来了很多资金。)

[Aria] But it also creates new pressures. Some beautiful natural places are getting too many visitors. The land and the plants are getting damaged.
(但它也带来了新的压力。一些美丽的自然景点迎来了太多的游客。土地和植物正在受到破坏。)

[Andrew] Yes, when too many persons go to one small place, it is hard to keep it clean and beautiful. The local governments have to work very hard to protect the environment.
(是的，当太多人去一个狭小的地方时，很难保持它的干净和美丽。当地政府必须非常努力地保护环境。)

[Aria] In addition, there is news about the price of aluminium, which is a very light metal used for making planes and cars.
(此外，还有关于铝价格的新闻，铝是一种用于制造飞机和汽车的非常轻的金属。)

[Andrew] The price of this metal has seen a slight recovery. The amount of metal in the stores of China is now stable.
(这种金属的价格已经出现轻微回升。中国商店里的金属数量目前保持稳定。)

[Aria] But experts say that the price will not go up much more. The upside room is limited.
(但专家表示，价格不会再上涨太多。上涨空间有限。)

[Andrew] This is because there is enough metal for the needs of the industry, so there is no danger of a shortage.
(这是因为有足够的金属满足工业的需要，所以没有短缺的危险。)

[Aria] Let us go to the United Kingdom. The Prime Minister, Keir Starmer, has made a very big statement.
(让我们去英国。首相 Keir Starmer 发表了一份非常重大的声明。)

[Andrew] He said that Britain will ban young persons under sixteen years of age from using social media apps. This includes TikTok and YouTube.
(他说，英国将禁止十六岁以下的年轻人使用社交媒体应用。这包括 TikTok 和 YouTube。)

[Aria] This is a very strong decision! TikTok and YouTube are used by almost every young person in the world.
(这是一个非常强烈的决定！TikTok 和 YouTube 几乎被世界上每一个年轻人所使用。)

[Andrew] Yes, they use them to watch videos, talk to friends, and get learning. But Keir Starmer says that these systems are causing damage to the minds of young persons.
(是的，他们用它们来看视频、和朋友聊天以及获取学习。但 Keir Starmer 说，这些系统正在对年轻人的心灵造成伤害。)

[Aria] Many fathers and mothers are happy about this news. They worry that their boys and girls are spending too much time looking at screens.
(许多父亲和母亲对这个消息感到高兴。他们担心他们的男孩和女孩花太多时间看屏幕。)

[Andrew] They also worry about bad things on the net, like cruel words from other children or false information.
(他们还担心网络上的不良事物，比如其他孩子残酷的话语或虚假信息。)

[Aria] But some young persons and campaigners are against this ban. They say it is not fair to stop them from using these tools.
(但一些年轻人和活动家反对这一禁令。他们说阻止他们使用这些工具是不公平的。)

[Andrew] They say that social media is a way for them to connect with the world and express themselves. If you ban it, they will feel shut out.
(他们说，社交媒体是他们与世界联系和表达自己的一种方式。如果你禁止它，他们会感到被排斥在外。)

[Aria] How will the government enforce this ban? How will they know the age of the user?
(政府将如何实施这一禁令？他们将如何知道用户的年龄？)

[Andrew] That is the biggest question. It is very hard to check the age of a person on the net. Some companies may have to use face-reading technology or official papers.
(那是最大的问题。在网上检查一个人的年龄是非常困难的。一些公司可能不得不使用人脸识别技术或官方文件。)

[Aria] Australia is also planning a similar ban. It seems that many nations are starting to think that the net is too dangerous for young minds.
(澳大利亚也在计划类似的禁令。似乎许多国家开始认为网络对年轻的心灵来说太危险了。)

[Andrew] Yes, we are seeing a big change in how governments view the world net. In the past, they let it grow without rules. Now, they want to control it.
(是的，我们看到政府对世界网络的看法发生了重大变化。过去，他们让它在没有规则的情况下发展。现在，他们想要控制它。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the G-7 meeting in France. The G-7 is a group of seven great nations of the earth.
(让我们谈谈在法国举行的 G-7 会议。G-7 是由地球上七个大国组成的集团。)

[Andrew] Trump has arrived for this meeting. But the other leaders are rethinking their relationship with the United States.
(Trump 已经到达参加这次会议。但其他领导人正在重新思考他们与美国的关系。)

[Aria] Why are they doing that? The US has always been the leader of this group.
(他们为什么要那样做？美国一直是这个集团的领导者。)

[Andrew] Because Trump has a very different view of the world. He wants "America First." He has put taxes on goods from other friendly nations, and he has made agreements without asking them.
(因为 Trump 对世界有着非常不同的看法。他想要“美国优先”。他对来自其他友好国家的商品征税，并在没有询问他们的情况下达成了协定。)

[Aria] Yes, the allies are planning for a world where they rely less on the US. They want to be able to stand on their own feet.
(是的，盟友们正在为一个减少对美国依赖的世界做计划。他们希望能够自立。)

[Andrew] At this meeting, the war in Iran will dominate the talks. The US-led war has caused much trouble and fear.
(在这次会议上，伊朗的战争将主导谈判。美国领导的战争引起了许多麻烦和恐惧。)

[Aria] Trump met with Macron, the leader of France, and Meloni, the leader of Italy.
(Trump 会见了法国领导人 Macron 和意大利领导人 Meloni。)

[Andrew] Their talks were very serious. Macron wants to keep the peace in Europe and the Middle East. But Trump wants to do things his own way.
(他们的会谈非常严肃。Macron 希望保持欧洲 and 中东的和平。但 Trump 想用自己的方式做事。)

[Aria] It is a very delicate time for the G-7. The harmony of the group is broken, and every nation is looking out for its own interests.
(对于 G-7 来说，这是一个非常微妙的时刻。该集团的和谐已被打破，每个国家都在寻找自己的利益。)

[Andrew] Now, we must talk about some very sad news from Ukraine.
(现在，我们必须谈谈来自乌克兰的一些非常悲伤的新闻。)

[Aria] Russian attacks have killed eleven persons and damaged a historic church in Kyiv.
(俄罗斯的袭击已造成十一人死亡，并损坏了基辅的一座历史悠久的教堂。)

[Andrew] This church is centuries old. It is a very holy and beautiful place for the people of Ukraine.
(这座教堂有几个世纪的历史。对于乌克兰人民来说，这是一个非常神圣和美丽的地方。)

[Aria] Yes, the attacks used flying bombs and drones. They caused a great fire at the church.
(是的，袭击使用了飞行炸弹和无人机。它们在教堂引起了大火。)

[Andrew] In addition, five persons were killed in Kharkiv, another great city in Ukraine.
(此外，在乌克兰另一个大城市哈尔科夫，有五人被杀。)

[Aria] This war has been going on for a long time, and the destruction is terrible. Famous landmarks and religious sites are being ruined.
(这场战争已经持续了很长时间，破坏是可怕的。著名的地标和宗教场所正在被毁坏。)

[Andrew] The public in Ukraine is living in constant fear. Every day, they have to listen for the sound of alarms and run to safe places under the ground.
(乌克兰的公众生活在不断的恐惧中。每天，他们都必须听警报声，并跑到地下的安全场所。)

[Aria] It is a cruel war that has caused so much death and pain. The world is watching, but no one has been able to stop the fighting.
(这是一场造成如此多死亡和痛苦的残酷战争。世界在看着，但没有人能够阻止战斗。)

[Andrew] We hope that some agreement for peace can be reached soon, so that the people of Ukraine can have a normal life again.
(我们希望很快能达成某种和平协定，使乌克兰人民能够重新过上正常的生活。)

[Aria] Finally, let us look at the reaction in Israel to the US-Iran deal.
(最后，让我们看看以色列对美伊协定的反应。)

[Andrew] The government of Israel, led by Netanyahu, is very angry. They say that Israel will not be bound by this deal.
(由 Netanyahu 领导的以色列政府非常生气。他们说以色列不会受这项协定的约束。)

[Aria] Netanyahu is facing a lot of criticism from his own country. The opposition group says that his strategy has been an "absolute failure."
(Netanyahu 正面临来自自己国家的许多批评。反对派团体表示，他的策略是一个“绝对的失败”。)

[Andrew] Why do they say that?
(他们为什么要那样说？)

[Aria] Because Netanyahu always said he would stop Iran from getting power. But now, the US has made a deal with Iran, and Israel was left out.
(因为 Netanyahu 总是说他会阻止伊朗获得力量。但现在，美国已经与伊朗达成了协定，而以色列被排除在外。)

[Andrew] Yes, and the deal apparently includes a ceasefire in Lebanon as well. Israeli officials are very defiant about this.
(是的，而且这项协定显然也包括在黎巴嫩停火。以色列官员对此非常挑衅。)

[Aria] They say that they must protect their own nation, and they will attack their enemies if they feel in danger, even if the US has a deal.
(他们说他们必须保护自己的国家，如果他们感到危险，即使美国达成了协定，他们也会攻击他们的敌人。)

[Andrew] This shows that the deal may not bring complete peace to the region. If Israel does not support it, there is still a big risk of war.
(这表明该协定可能不会给该地区带来完全的和平。如果以色列不支持它，战争的风险仍然很大。)

[Aria] Netanyahu is going to give a statement to the public tonight. Everyone will be listening to his words very carefully.
(Netanyahu 今晚将向公众发表声明。每个人都会非常仔细地听他的话。)

[Andrew] That is all the news we have for tonight. We have talked about many important events across the earth.
(这就是我们今晚的全部新闻。我们谈到了地球上许多重要的事件。)

[Aria] We hope that this talk has been helpful for your English learning. By using simple words, we hope you can understand these complex stories.
(我们希望这次谈话对您的英语学习有所帮助。通过使用简单的词汇，我们希望您能理解这些复杂的故事。)

[Andrew] Yes, keep listening and reading. It is the best way to get a strong grip on the language.
(是的，保持听和读。这是牢牢掌握这门语言的最佳方法。)

[Aria] Thank you for being with us. Good night!
(谢谢您和我们在一起。晚安！)

[Andrew] Good night!
(晚安！)

item.title: 2026-06-15 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning, dear friends. Welcome to our morning news talk.
(早上好，亲爱的朋友们。欢迎收听我们的晨间新闻对话。)

[Andrew] Good morning, Aria. It is great to be here with you today. We have many important stories to talk about.
(早上好，Aria。今天很高兴能在这里和你在一起。我们有很多重要的故事要聊。)

[Aria] Yes, Andrew. Today we will talk about peace, new machines, safety, and rules for young people.
(是的，Andrew。今天我们将谈论和平、新机器、安全以及针对年轻人的规则。)

[Andrew] That is right. Our first story is very big. It is about a new agreement between the United States and Iran.
(没错。我们的第一个故事非常重大。是关于美国和伊朗之间的一项新协议。)

[Aria] This agreement is to end the war. It is a very great event for the world.
(这项协议旨在结束战争。这对世界来说是一个非常重大的事件。)

[Andrew] Yes, and because of this agreement, the money markets are jumping. In Japan, the Nikkei went up by five percent.
(是的，因为这项协议，金融市场正在大涨。在日本，日经指数上涨了百分之五。)

[Aria] That is a very big increase. Why did the market go up so fast, Andrew?
(那是一个非常大的涨幅。Andrew，为什么市场上涨得这么快？)

[Andrew] Well, Aria, when there is war, people are afraid. They do not want to put their money in companies. But when there is peace, they feel safe.
(嗯，Aria，当有战争时，人们会害怕。他们不想把钱投进公司。但是当有了和平，他们会感到安全。)

[Aria] I see. So peace makes people want to do business again. What about the price of oil?
(我明白了。所以和平让人们想重新做生意。那石油价格呢？)

[Andrew] The price of oil went down very fast. This is because Iran can now send its oil to other countries again.
(石油价格下跌得非常快。这是因为伊朗现在可以再次向其他国家发送石油了。)

[Aria] That is good for people who buy oil. If the price of oil is low, the cost of making things will be less.
(这对购买石油的人来说是好事。如果石油价格低，制造东西的成本就会减少。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is a very good cycle. But there is also some trouble. Trump has said some very sharp words about Netanyahu.
(是的，这是一个非常好的循环。但也有一些麻烦。特朗普对内塔尼亚胡说了一些非常尖锐的话。)

[Aria] Oh? What did Trump say?
(哦？特朗普说了什么？)

[Andrew] Trump said that Netanyahu has no judgment. This was after Netanyahu made an attack on Beirut in Lebanon.
(特朗普说内塔尼亚胡没有判断力。这是在内塔尼亚胡对黎巴嫩贝鲁特发动袭击之后说的。)

[Aria] Why is Trump angry about this attack?
(为什么特朗普对这次袭击感到愤怒？)

[Andrew] Because this attack could break the peace agreement with Iran. Trump warned Netanyahu not to blow it.
(因为这次袭击可能会破坏与伊朗的和平协议。特朗普警告内塔尼亚胡不要搞砸了。)

[Aria] I understand. Peace is very delicate. If one nation attacks another, the whole agreement can fall apart.
(我理解。和平是非常脆弱的。如果一个国家攻击另一个国家，整个协议都可能瓦解。)

[Andrew] Yes, peace needs everyone to work together. Trump said that Netanyahu almost ruined the agreement. He said Netanyahu should thank the United States for making the agreement.
(是的，和平需要每个人共同努力。特朗普说内塔尼亚胡几乎毁了这项协议。他说内塔尼亚胡应该感谢美国达成了这项协议。)

[Aria] It is a very complex condition. We must watch it closely. Now, let us talk about another person in the money world. His name is Warsh.
(这是一个非常复杂的状况。我们必须密切观察。现在，让我们谈谈金融界的另一个人。他的名字叫 Warsh。)

[Andrew] Ah, Warsh is caught in the middle. He is between Trump and the market for government debt papers.
(啊，Warsh 夹在中间。他介于特朗普和政府国债纸张市场之间。)

[Aria] What is the trouble there, Andrew?
(那里的麻烦是什么，Andrew？)

[Andrew] The market is betting that interest rates will go up. But Trump wants interest rates to be low. Warsh has to make a very hard decision.
(市场正在押注利率将会上升。但特朗普希望利率保持在低位。Warsh 必须做出一个非常艰难的决定。)

[Aria] If interest rates go up, it costs more to borrow money. That can slow down business. But if they are too low, prices might go up too fast.
(如果利率上升，借钱的成本就会更高。这可能会放慢商业活动。但如果利率太低，物价可能会上涨得太快。)

[Andrew] Exactly. It is a balance. Warsh must find the right way, but both sides are pushing him very hard.
(确实如此。这是一种平衡。Warsh 必须找到正确的方法，但双方都在给他施加很大的压力。)

[Aria] Let us move to our second segment. It is about technology and AI. Apple has made a very big change to Siri.
(让我们进入第二个环节。是关于技术和人工智能的。苹果对 Siri 做了一个非常大的改变。)

[Andrew] Yes, Siri has a new brain now. This is a very big step for Apple.
(是的，Siri 现在有了一个新大脑。这对苹果来说是一个非常大的进步。)

[Aria] Many people say that Siri was not very smart before. It could not understand complex questions.
(许多人说 Siri 以前不是很聪明。它无法理解复杂的问题。)

[Andrew] That is true. For a long time, Siri was just a simple voice in your pocket machine. It could only do simple things like setting a clock or calling a friend.
(那是真的。很长一段时间，Siri 只是你口袋机器里一个简单的声音。它只能做简单的事情，比如定闹钟或给朋友打电话。)

[Aria] But now, other companies have made very smart thinking machines. Apple was in a crisis because they were late.
(但是现在，其他公司已经制造出了非常聪明的思考机器。苹果因为落后而陷入了危机。)

[Andrew] Yes, they had to act quickly. This new update is their answer. It makes Siri much more like a real person who can think and help you.
(是的，他们必须迅速行动。这个新更新就是他们的回答。它让 Siri 更像一个能够思考并帮助你的真人。)

[Aria] But the news says that now the real challenge begins. Why is that?
(但新闻说，现在真正的挑战才刚刚开始。这是为什么？)

[Andrew] Because making a smart machine is only the first part. Now, Apple must make sure that millions of people use it every day without errors.
(因为制造一台聪明的机器只是第一步。现在，苹果必须确保数百万人在每天使用它时不会出错。)

[Aria] And they must keep the user's private details safe. If the machine knows too much about you, it could be dangerous if that information gets out.
(而且他们必须保护用户的隐私细节安全。如果机器对你了解太多，一旦这些信息泄露出去，可能会很危险。)

[Andrew] Yes, safety of personal details is a very big point. People will not use Siri if they do not trust Apple.
(是的，个人细节的安全是一个非常重要的点。如果人们不信任苹果，他们就不会使用 Siri。)

[Aria] There is also another rumor about Apple. They might make a folding pocket machine that costs one thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine dollars.
(还有另一个关于苹果的传闻。他们可能会制造一款售价一千九百九十九美元的折叠口袋机器。)

[Andrew] That is a very high price. Almost two thousand dollars for a pocket machine.
(那是一个非常高的价格。一个口袋机器几乎要两千美元。)

[Aria] Yes, but the news says this high-price machine could help keep other iPhone prices low.
(是的，但新闻说这款高价机器可以帮助保持其他 iPhone 的价格处于低位。)

[Andrew] How does that work?
(那是怎么起作用的？)

[Andrew] Well, if Apple has a very expensive luxury machine, they do not need to raise the price of the normal machines. The normal machines can stay at a price that more people can pay.
(嗯，如果苹果有一款非常昂贵的奢侈机器，他们就不需要提高普通机器的价格。普通机器可以保持在更多人能够支付的价格。)

[Aria] That makes sense. It gives people a choice. If you want the newest folding glass face, you pay a lot. If you want a normal one, you pay less.
(这很有道理。它给人们提供了选择。如果你想要最新款的折叠玻璃面，你就要付很多钱。如果你想要一个普通的，你付的钱就少一些。)

[Andrew] Yes. And they are also making changes to the system. In iOS 27, they are adding a wide view to more programs. This is for the new folding machines and maybe even a touch-screen computer.
(是的。而且他们也在对系统进行更改。在 iOS 27 中，他们正在为更多程序添加宽视图。这是为了新的折叠机器，甚至可能是触摸屏电脑。)

[Aria] A touch-screen computer from Apple. That would be a very big change. For many years, they said they would not do that.
(苹果的触摸屏电脑。那将是一个非常大的改变。多年来，他们一直说他们不会那样做。)

[Andrew] Yes, but the market changes, and companies must change too if they want to get profits.
(是的，但是市场在变，公司如果想获得利润，也必须改变。)

[Aria] Speaking of AI and the government, we have a very strange story about Anthropic.
(说到 AI 和政府，我们有一个关于 Anthropic 的非常奇怪的故事。)

[Andrew] Yes, this is a very serious event. The White House has stopped Anthropic's top AI system, which is named Mythos.
(是的，这是一个非常严重的事件。白宫已经停止了 Anthropic 最顶尖的 AI 系统，该系统名为 Mythos。)

[Aria] Why did the government do that?
(政府为什么要那样做？)

[Andrew] It started with a warning from Amazon. Amazon told the government that there was a danger.
(这始于亚马逊的一个警告。亚马逊告诉政府存在危险。)

[Aria] What kind of danger?
(什么样的危险？)

[Andrew] The government was worried that people from other nations were using this very strong thinking machine. They do not want other countries to get this technology because it could be used for war or bad things.
(政府担心来自其他国家的人正在使用这个非常强大的思考机器。他们不希望其他国家获得这项技术，因为它可能会被用于战争或坏事。)

[Aria] So they made a rule to stop foreign nationals from using it.
(所以他们制定了一条规则，阻止外国国民使用它。)

[Andrew] Yes. And Anthropic had to suspend all access to the Mythos system. They even flew their workers to Washington D.C. to talk to the government.
(是的。Anthropic 必须暂停对 Mythos 系统的一切访问。他们甚至派员工飞往华盛顿特区与政府谈判。)

[Aria] That shows how important AI has become. It is not just a toy or a simple tool. It is now a matter of national safety.
(这表明 AI 已经变得多么重要。它不仅仅是一个玩具或一个简单的工具。它现在关系到国家安全。)

[Andrew] Yes, governments are very afraid of what these machines can do if they fall into the wrong hands.
(是的，政府非常害怕这些机器如果落入坏人手中会做出什么事。)

[Aria] It must be very hard for the company. They spent so much money to make this system, and now they cannot let people use it.
(对公司来说这一定非常艰难。他们花了这么多钱来制造这个系统，现在却不能让人们使用它。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is a big loss of money for them. They are working very hard to resolve the limits with the government.
(是的，这对他们来说是巨大的资金损失。他们正在非常努力地与政府解决这些限制。)

[Aria] Let us move to our third segment. This is about safety and health. There is a recall of baby food.
(让我们进入第三个环节。这是关于安全和健康的。有一项关于婴儿食品的召回。)

[Andrew] Yes, a company named Nara Organics has taken back its baby milk powder.
(是的，一家名为 Nara Organics 的公司已经收回了其婴儿奶粉。)

[Aria] Why did they take it back?
(他们为什么要收回它？)

[Andrew] Because three babies were diagnosed with a very bad disease called botulism.
(因为有三个婴儿被诊断出患有一种名为肉毒杆菌中毒的非常严重的疾病。)

[Aria] Oh, that is terrible. What is botulism?
(哦，那太可怕了。什么是肉毒杆菌中毒？)

[Andrew] It is a very strong poison that comes from bad bacteria. It can make a baby very ill, and they cannot move their muscles. It can even cause death if they cannot breathe.
(这是一种来自有害细菌的非常强烈的毒素。它会让婴儿病得很重，使他们的肌肉无法活动。如果他们无法呼吸，它甚至会导致死亡。)

[Aria] That is so scary for parents. Where was this baby food sold?
(这对父母来说太可怕了。这种婴儿食品是在哪里销售的？)

[Andrew] It was sold at Target stores in many states. The FDA is now searching for the facts to see how the poison got into the powder.
(它在许多州的 Target 商店销售。FDA 现在正在寻找事实，以查明毒素是如何进入奶粉的。)

[Aria] If parents have this baby food at home, they must throw it away immediately or take it back to the store.
(如果父母家里有这种婴儿食品，他们必须立即将其扔掉或退回商店。)

[Andrew] Yes, they must not give it to their babies. Safety must come first.
(是的，他们绝对不能把它给婴儿吃。安全必须放在第一位。)

[Aria] Now, let us talk about another safety story. This one is about flying in a plane.
(现在，让我们谈谈另一个安全故事。这个是关于乘飞机飞行的。)

[Andrew] Yes, plane drivers and helpers have revealed some things that travelers do that are much more dangerous than people think.
(是的，飞机驾驶员和助手们透露了旅行者所做的一些比人们想象的要危险得多的事情。)

[Aria] What is one example of these dangerous things?
(这些危险事情的一个例子是什么？)

[Andrew] One big thing is not putting on the seat band when the sign is off.
(一大件事是在指示灯熄灭时没有系好座椅安全带。)

[Aria] But if the sign is off, does that not mean it is safe to take it off?
(但是如果指示灯熄灭了，那不就意味着可以安全地解开它了吗？)

[Andrew] Not always, Aria. The air can move very suddenly. This is called turbulence. If the plane drops suddenly and you do not have your seat band on, you can fly up and hit your head on the roof.
(不总是这样，Aria。空气会非常突然地流动。这被称为气流。如果飞机突然下降而你没有系好座椅安全带，你可能会飞起来，头部撞到机舱顶部。)

[Aria] That sounds very painful and dangerous. I will always keep my seat band on now, even if the sign is off.
(这听起来非常痛苦和危险。即使指示灯熄灭了，我以后也一定会一直系着安全带。)

[Andrew] Yes, that is a very wise decision. Another thing is taking off your shoes during the flight.
(是的，那是一个非常明智的决定。另一件事是在飞行过程中脱掉鞋子。)

[Aria] Why is taking off shoes dangerous? Is it just because of the smell?
(为什么脱掉鞋子很危险？只是因为气味吗？)

[Andrew] No, it is not just about the smell. If there is an emergency and everyone must leave the plane quickly, you do not want to be looking for your shoes. The floor could be very hot, or there could be broken glass and sharp metal.
(不，不仅仅是因为气味。如果发生紧急情况，每个人都必须迅速离开飞机，你肯定不想在那时寻找你的鞋子。地面可能会非常热，或者可能会有碎玻璃和锋利的金属。)

[Aria] I see. If you do not have shoes, you cannot run fast to save your life.
(我明白了。如果你没有鞋子，你就无法快速奔跑来救自己的命。)

[Andrew] Exactly. And also, the floor of the plane toilet is very dirty. You do not want to walk there with only your socks or bare feet.
(确实如此。而且，飞机厕所的地板非常脏。你肯定不想只穿袜子或光着脚走到那里。)

[Aria] That is very true. I will keep my shoes on from now on. What about drinking?
(那非常真实。从现在起我会一直穿着鞋子。那喝酒呢？)

[Andrew] Drinking too much strong drink is also very dangerous. In the high air, the effect of wine is much stronger on your body. You can get drunk much faster, and you might make bad decisions or start a fight.
(喝太多烈酒也非常危险。在高空中，酒对你身体的影响要强烈得多。你会醉得快得多，你可能会做出错误的决定或引发打架。)

[Aria] Yes, and if there is trouble, a drunk person cannot follow the safety rules quickly.
(是的，如果遇到麻烦，醉酒的人无法迅速遵守安全规则。)

[Andrew] Yes, the helpers on the plane are there to keep you safe, not just to give you food and drinks. We must listen to them.
(是的，飞机上的助手们是在那里保护你安全的，不仅仅是给你提供食物和饮料。我们必须听从他们的话。)

[Aria] Let us move to our fourth segment. This is about world news and rules. In the UK, the chief of the government, Starmer, is planning a new rule for young people.
(让我们进入第四个环节。这是关于世界新闻和规则的。在英国，政府首脑 Starmer 正在为年轻人计划一项新规则。)

[Andrew] Yes, he wants to stop young people under sixteen years of age from using major public net places for talking.
(是的，他想阻止十六岁以下的年轻人使用主要的公共网络聊天场所。)

[Aria] That is a very big rule. Why does he want to do this?
(那是一个非常大的规则。他为什么要这样做？)

[Andrew] Because there is a lot of worry about the mental health of young people. Many children spend too much time on their pocket machines, looking at things that make them sad or angry.
(因为人们非常担心年轻人的心理健康。许多孩子在他们的口袋机器上花了太多时间，看着那些让他们感到悲伤或愤怒的东西。)

[Aria] Yes, and there is also the danger of bad people talking to children online.
(是的，而且还存在坏人在网上与孩子们交谈的危险。)

[Andrew] Yes. The plan also includes a night limit for teens and a stop on using talking machines, or chatbots.
(是的。该计划还包括对青少年的夜间限制，以及停止使用聊天机器人的规定。)

[Aria] Some people say this rule is too hard. They say parents should decide, not the government.
(有些人说这个规则太严厉了。他们说应该由父母来决定，而不是政府。)

[Andrew] That is the argument. But Starmer believes that the government must act to keep children safe because the companies that own these net places do not do enough to protect them.
(这就是争论所在。但 Starmer 认为，政府必须采取行动保护儿童安全，因为拥有这些网络场所的公司在保护他们方面做得不够。)

[Aria] It is a very important discussion. Other countries, like Australia, are also making similar rules.
(这是一个非常重要的讨论。其他国家，比如澳大利亚，也在制定类似的规则。)

[Andrew] Yes, it seems to be a new direction for many nations. We will see if it works.
(是的，这似乎是许多国家的新方向。我们将看看它是否有效。)

[Aria] Now, let us talk about a dramatic event in the narrow sea between the UK and France.
(现在，让我们谈谈在英国和法国之间的狭窄海域发生的一起戏剧性事件。)

[Andrew] Ah, the Royal Marines, who are the sea soldiers of the UK, have gone on a secret Russian oil ship.
(啊，皇家海军陆战队，也就是英国的海军士兵，登上了一艘秘密的俄罗斯石油船。)

[Aria] Why did they do that?
(他们为什么要那样做？)

[Andrew] Because they think this ship is part of Russia's secret group of oil ships. These are ships that carry oil even though there are rules against trading with Russia.
(因为他们认为这艘船是俄罗斯秘密石油船队的一部分。这些是在尽管有禁止与俄罗斯贸易的规则下仍然运送石油的船只。)

[Aria] I see. Russia is trying to sell its oil to get money for the war, and the UK is trying to stop them.
(我明白了。俄罗斯正试图出售其石油以获取战争资金，而英国正试图阻止他们。)

[Andrew] Yes, the UK has put punishment rules on these ships. They stopped this ship in the English Channel to search it and keep it from going further.
(是的，英国对这些船只实施了惩罚规则。他们在英吉利海峡拦截了这艘船，对其进行搜查并阻止其继续航行。)

[Aria] That must have been a very tense moment. Going onto a foreign ship in the middle of the sea is not easy.
(那一定是一个非常紧张的时刻。在海中央登上一艘外国船只并不容易。)

[Andrew] No, it is very dangerous. But the sea soldiers are trained for this. It shows that the UK is very serious about enforcing the rules against Russia.
(不，这非常危险。但海军士兵接受过这方面的训练。这表明英国在执行针对俄罗斯的规则方面非常认真。)

[Aria] Our last story is a very sad one from Yemen. It is about a man who was known as the Spider-Man of Yemen.
(我们的最后一个故事是来自也门的一个非常悲伤的故事。是关于一个被称为也门蜘蛛侠的男人的故事。)

[Andrew] Yes, he has met his death after a fall from a fire mountain mouth.
(是的，他在从一个火山口坠落后不幸身亡。)

[Aria] Oh, that is very sad. Why was he called the Spider-Man of Yemen?
(哦，那太令人悲伤了。他为什么被称为也门蜘蛛侠？)

[Andrew] Because he was famous for going up very high walls and mountains without any cords or safety gear. He did it with only his hands and feet.
(因为他以在没有任何绳索或安全装备的情况下攀爬非常高的墙壁和山脉而闻名。他仅凭双手和双脚就做到了。)

[Aria] That is incredibly dangerous. Why did he do it?
(那真是令人难以置信的危险。他为什么要这样做？)

[Andrew] He loved the feeling of being high up, and it brought amusement to many people who watched him. But this time, he was going up a hollow place on a fire mountain, and he lost his grip.
(他喜欢在高处的感觉，这也给许多观看他的人带来了娱乐。但这一次，他正在攀爬一个火山口的空洞处，结果失去了抓地力。)

[Aria] It is a tragic end for a very brave man. It reminds us that nature is very strong, and we must always respect the danger.
(对于一个非常勇敢的人来说，这是一个悲剧性的结局。它提醒我们，大自然非常强大，我们必须时刻尊重危险。)

[Andrew] Yes, even the most expert people can make an error. We must always think about safety first.
(是的，即使是最专业的人也会犯错。我们必须始终把安全放在第一位。)

[Aria] That is very true, Andrew. Well, we have covered many important stories today.
(那非常真实，Andrew。好了，我们今天报道了许多重要的故事。)

[Andrew] Yes, we talked about the peace agreement between the US and Iran, and how it made the markets go up and oil prices go down.
(是的，我们谈到了美伊和平协议，以及它是如何让市场上涨和石油价格下跌的。)

[Aria] We also talked about Trump's angry words to Netanyahu, and the difficult position of Warsh in the money market.
(我们还谈到了特朗普对内塔尼亚胡的愤怒言论，以及 Warsh 在金融市场中的艰难处境。)

[Andrew] In technology, we discussed Siri's new brain and Apple's plans for a folding pocket machine.
(在技术方面，我们讨论了 Siri 的新大脑以及苹果对折叠口袋机器的计划。)

[Aria] And we learned about the government stopping Anthropic's Mythos system because of safety worries.
(我们还了解到政府出于安全担忧停止了 Anthropic 的 Mythos 系统。)

[Andrew] For safety, we talked about the Nara Organics baby food recall and the dangerous things people do on planes.
(为了安全，我们谈到了 Nara Organics 婴儿食品召回以及人们在飞机上做的危险事情。)

[Aria] Finally, we talked about the social media rules for young people in the UK, the Russian ship seizure, and the sad death of the Yemen Spider-Man.
(最后，我们谈到了英国针对年轻人的社交媒体规则、俄罗斯船只被扣押，以及也门蜘蛛侠的悲惨死亡。)

[Andrew] It was a very full day of news. I hope our friends learned many new words and structures today.
(这是非常充实的一天新闻。我希望我们的朋友今天学到了许多新单词和结构。)

[Aria] Yes, learning English through the news is a very good way to improve. Thank you for being with us, Andrew.
(是的，通过新闻学习英语是提高英语水平的一个非常好的方法。谢谢你和我们在一起，Andrew。)

[Andrew] Thank you, Aria. See you next time!
(谢谢你，Aria。下次见！)

[Aria] Goodbye, everyone! Have a safe and happy day!
(再见，大家！祝你们度过安全快乐的一天！)

item.title: 2026-06-16 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
