[Aria] Good morning. It is good to have you here with us for our morning news talk. I am Aria.
(早上好。很高兴您能和我们一起收听早间新闻谈话。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. It is very good to be here with you this day. We have many important stories to talk about.
(我是 Andrew。今天很高兴能在这里和大家在一起。我们有很多重要的故事要聊。)

[Aria] Yes, we do. We will talk about new machines, big business agreements, and events across the earth. Let us start with the story about Apple and their voice system, Siri.
(是的，确实。我们将谈论新机器、重大商业协议以及地球上发生的事件。让我们从关于苹果公司及其语音系统 Siri 的故事开始吧。)

[Andrew] This is a very interesting story, Aria. Many persons have been waiting for a new Siri. They wanted Siri to be more wise and helpful. Now, Apple has made a big change in iOS 27. But why did it take so long?
(这是一个非常有趣的故事，Aria。很多人一直在等待一个新的 Siri。他们希望 Siri 能够更聪明、更有帮助。现在，苹果在 iOS 27 中做出了重大改变。但为什么花了这么长时间呢？)

[Aria] Apple says it is because making a new brain for Siri is very hard. The old Siri only did simple things. If you said, What is the weather this day? it could answer. But if you wanted it to do complex things, it could not. To make Siri wise, they had to build a new system. This system uses a new form of learning for machines.
(苹果表示，这是因为给 Siri 制造一个新大脑非常困难。旧的 Siri 只能做简单的事情。如果你说：“今天天气怎么样？”它能回答。但如果你想让它做复杂的事情，它就无能为力了。为了让 Siri 变得聪明，他们必须建立一个全新的系统。这个系统使用了一种新的机器物理学习形式。)

[Andrew] Yes, and they had to make sure this new brain could run on a small machine, like a pocket machine. They did not want all the thoughts to go to a far-off building with big machines. They wanted the pocket machine to do the work. This keeps the private details of the owner safe. This is a very important point for Apple.
(是的，他们必须确保这个新大脑可以在小型机器上运行，比如口袋机器。他们不希望所有的想法都传到装有大型机器的遥远大楼里。他们希望口袋机器自己来完成这项工作。这样可以保护所有者的私密信息安全。这对苹果来说是非常重要的一点。)

[Aria] That is true. Apple always says that keeping our private details safe is their chief care. But making a wise system run on a small machine takes a long time. They had to test it many times. They had to make sure the battery of the pocket machine does not go flat quickly. If a wise system uses too much power, the machine will get warm and stop working.
(确实如此。苹果总是说，保护我们的私密信息安全是他们首要关心的事。但在小型机器上运行智能系统需要很长时间。他们必须测试很多次。他们必须确保口袋机器的电池不会很快耗尽。如果智能系统消耗太多能量，机器就会变热并停止工作。)

[Andrew] I agree. And we also have news about the history of Apple machines. It has been twenty years since Apple made a big decision to use Intel engines in their Mac machines. Before that, they used different engines. But those old engines were too warm and did not have enough power. So, Apple went to Intel.
(我同意。我们还有关于苹果机器历史的新闻。自苹果做出在 Mac 机器中使用英特尔引擎的重大决定以来，已经过去了二十年。在那之前，他们使用不同的引擎。但那些旧引擎太热了，而且动力不足。所以，苹果转向了英特尔。)

[Aria] That was a very big change twenty years ago. It helped Apple make much better Mac machines. But then, a few years ago, Apple made another big change. They stopped using Intel engines. They started to make their own engines, which they call Apple Silicon. Why did they do this?
(二十年前那是一个非常重大的改变。它帮助苹果制造了更好的 Mac 机器。但是，几年前，苹果又做出了另一个重大改变。他们停止使用英特尔引擎。他们开始制造自己的引擎，称之为 Apple Silicon。他们为什么要这样做？)

[Andrew] Because they wanted more control. They wanted their machines to use less power and stay cold. With Intel, they had to wait for another company to make new engines. With their own engines, they can make changes whenever they want. Now we see that the new macOS system will slowly stop supporting programs made for Intel engines.
(因为他们想要更多的控制权。他们希望自己的机器使用更少的能量并保持低温。使用英特尔，他们必须等待另一家公司制造新引擎。使用自己的引擎，他们可以随时做出改变。现在我们看到新的 macOS 系统将慢慢停止支持为英特尔引擎制作的程序。)

[Aria] This is the end of an old time. If you have a very old Mac with an Intel engine, it will not get the new changes. This shows how fast science and machines move forward. It is necessary to change our machines after some years to keep up with new ideas.
(这是一个旧时代的结束。如果你有一台带有英特尔引擎的非常旧的 Mac，它将无法获得新的改变。这展示了科学和机器向前发展的速度有多快。几年后有必要更换我们的机器，以跟上新思想的步伐。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is. Now, speaking of machines having trouble, let us talk about Google. Google has a wise system called Gemini. But recently, Gemini had a big problem. Many persons who use Android machines found that Gemini could not make calls for them.
(是的，确实如此。现在，说到机器出现问题，让我们来谈谈谷歌。谷歌有一个名为 Gemini 的智能系统。但最近，Gemini 遇到了一个大问题。许多使用安卓机器的人发现 Gemini 无法为他们拨打电话。)

[Aria] Yes, this was a sudden problem. Persons would say, Call my friend, and the machine would say, Something went wrong. This happened on pocket machines and also in carriages that use Android Auto. It was a big trouble for persons who were driving.
(是的，这是一个突然出现的问题。人们会说“给我的朋友打电话”，机器就会说“出了点问题”。这发生在口袋机器上，也发生在运行 Android Auto 的汽车里。对于正在开车的人来说，这是一个很大的麻烦。)

[Andrew] Driving and trying to use your hands to make a call is not safe. That is why we have these voice systems. When they stop working, it can be dangerous. Google said they knew about the error and were working to make it well. It is interesting that while Gemini was down, the main Google Search system was still working fine.
(开车时试着用手打电话是不安全的。这就是我们拥有这些语音系统的原因。当它们停止工作时，可能会很危险。谷歌表示他们知道这个错误，并正在努力修复。有趣的是，虽然 Gemini 瘫痪了，但谷歌的主要搜索系统仍然运行良好。)

[Aria] That is a good point. It shows us how dependent we are on these new systems. When they stop working, our daily behavior has to change. We realize how much we use them for simple acts like calling our family or finding a road.
(这是一个很好的观点。它向我们展示了我们对这些新系统的依赖程度。当它们停止工作时，我们的日常行为就必须改变。我们意识到我们在多么频繁地使用它们来做一些简单的行为，比如给家人打电话或找路。)

[Andrew] Yes, we take them for granted until they break. Now, let us move to the business of play and amusement. Xbox, which is owned by Microsoft, is shutting down a company called Ninja Theory. This company made a very famous play called Hellblade. This news has made many persons sad and angry.
(是的，在它们坏掉之前，我们都觉得这是理所当然的。现在，让我们转向游戏和娱乐业务。微软旗下的 Xbox 正在关闭一家名为 Ninja Theory 的公司。这家公司制作了一款非常著名的游戏，名叫《地狱之刃》。这个消息让很多人感到难过和愤怒。)

[Aria] I can understand why they are angry. Ninja Theory is a group of very creative persons. They made plays that had deep stories and beautiful art. They were not just making simple plays for money. They were making art. But Xbox is making big changes to its business.
(我能理解他们为什么愤怒。Ninja Theory 是一群非常有创造力的人。他们制作了具有深刻故事和美丽艺术的游戏。他们不仅仅是为了钱而制作简单的游戏。他们是在创造艺术。但 Xbox 正在对其业务做出重大调整。)

[Andrew] The chief of Microsoft said they need to make their play business sustainable. This means they want to make more profit and spend less money. It seems that big companies are buying smaller companies, and then shutting them down when they do not make enough money quickly.
(微软的负责人表示，他们需要让游戏业务可持续发展。这意味着他们希望赚取更多利润并减少开支。似乎大公司正在收购较小的公司，然后当它们不能快速赚到足够的钱时就将其关闭。)

[Aria] This is a hard condition for the persons who make these plays. They lose their work, and the public loses great art. Many persons are asking if this is the right way to run a business. If we only care about money, we might lose all the beautiful things that persons make.
(对于制作这些游戏的人来说，这是一个艰难的处境。他们失去了工作，公众也失去了伟大的艺术。许多人都在问这是否是经营业务的正确方式。如果我们只关心钱，我们可能会失去人们创造的所有美好事物。)

[Andrew] That is a very serious thought, Aria. The balance between art and money is always hard to keep. When big corporations control everything, art often suffers. We hope the creative minds from Ninja Theory can find new places to do their great work.
(这是一个非常严肃的想法，Aria。艺术和金钱之间的平衡总是很难保持。当大公司控制一切时，艺术往往会受到伤害。我们希望来自 Ninja Theory 的创意人才能够找到新的地方来继续他们伟大的工作。)

[Aria] Yes, let us hope so. Now, let us change to a story about trade and the price of oil. There is a very important water way called the Strait of Hormuz. A lot of the earth's oil goes through this narrow water. Recently, there was a big danger that this water way would be shut because of fights between nations.
(是的，让我们这样希望吧。现在，让我们转到一个关于贸易和石油价格的故事。有一条非常重要的水道叫做霍尔木兹海峡。地球上的很多石油都经过这片狭窄的水域。最近，由于国家之间的冲突，这条水道面临着被关闭的巨大危险。)

[Andrew] Yes, if that water way is shut, the price of oil all over the earth goes up very fast. This is because companies cannot get the oil to the places that need it. But now there is a new agreement between the United States and Iran. This agreement has made the condition much better.
(是的，如果那条水道被关闭，整个地球的石油价格就会快速上涨。这是因为公司无法将石油运送到需要的地方。但现在美国和伊朗达成了一项新协议。这项协议使情况大为好转。)

[Aria] Because of this agreement, the Strait of Hormuz will stay open, and oil can move freely again. This is great news for the market. And because of this, the price of oil has fallen. In the United States, the average price of oil for engines has fallen below four dollars for a gallon.
(正因为如此，霍尔木兹海峡将保持开放，石油可以再次自由流动。这对市场来说是个好消息。也因为这项协议，石油价格下跌了。在美国，发动机用油的平均价格已降至每加仑四美元以下。)

[Andrew] This is the first time it has been this low since the middle of April. It gives comfort to many families who have to spend a lot of money on driving. When the price of oil goes down, the cost of moving food and other things also goes down. So, it can help to make other prices lower too.
(这是自四月中旬以来首次降至如此低的水平。这给许多必须在驾驶上花很多钱的家庭带来了安慰。当石油价格下跌时，运输食品和其他物品的成本也会下降。因此，它也可以帮助降低其他价格。)

[Aria] But some experts say we must be careful. The agreement is new, and things could change again if there is more trouble in the Middle East. We must watch the news closely to see if the peace will last. It is a delicate balance.
(但一些专家表示，我们必须小心。该协议是新达成的，如果中东出现更多麻烦，情况可能会再次发生变化。我们必须密切关注新闻，看看和平是否会持续。这是一个微妙的平衡。)

[Andrew] It is indeed. Now, let us talk about another big business story. The United States government made a rule against using models from a company called Anthropic. Some persons thought this was because of a jailbreak, which means someone made the system do something bad that it was not designed to do.
(确实如此。现在，让我们谈谈另一个重大的商业故事。美国政府制定了一项规则，禁止使用一家名为 Anthropic 的公司的模型。有些人认为这是因为“越狱”，这意味着有人让系统做了一些它原本不该做的坏事。)

[Aria] But the news now says it was not about that. It was about trust. The White House lost its belief in Anthropic. There were discussions about how safe their systems really are. The government wants to be very sure that these powerful systems do not cause destruction or give secrets to other nations.
(但现在的消息说，事情并非如此。这是关于信任的问题。白宫失去了对 Anthropic 的信任。关于他们的系统到底有多安全，存在着讨论。政府希望非常确定这些强大的系统不会造成破坏或向其他国家泄露秘密。)

[Andrew] Yes, these systems are very powerful. They can write code, make plans, and answer complex questions. If a bad person gets control of them, they can do a lot of damage. That is why the government is so careful. Now officials from the government of Trump are meeting with Anthropic to talk about an agreement.
(是的，这些系统非常强大。它们可以编写代码、制定计划并回答复杂的问题。如果坏人控制了它们，他们会造成很大的破坏。这就是为什么政府如此小心。现在特朗普政府的官员正在与 Anthropic 会面，商讨一项协议。)

[Aria] They want to find a way to work together again. This shows how important these new systems are for the power of a nation. The government wants to control them, but they also need them to be strong so that their nation does not fall behind other nations.
(他们希望找到一种再次合作的方法。这表明这些新系统对一个国家的力量有多么重要。政府想要控制它们，但他们也需要它们变得强大，这样他们的国家才不会落后于其他国家。)

[Andrew] It is a very difficult position for the company. They want to make great things, but they must also follow the rules of the government. If they do not, they cannot sell their products to the biggest buyer, which is the government itself.
(对这家公司来说，这是一个非常艰难的处境。他们想要创造伟大的事物，但他们也必须遵守政府的规则。如果他们不这样做，他们就无法将产品卖给最大的买家，也就是政府本身。)

[Aria] Let us look at another big business deal. Fox is buying a company called Roku for twenty-two billion dollars. Roku is a company that makes machines and systems for viewing pictures and sound on television. This is a very big bet by Fox.
(让我们来看看另一笔重大的商业交易。福克斯正以220亿美元的价格收购一家名为 Roku 的公司。Roku 是一家制造用于在电视上观看图像和声音的机器和系统的公司。这是福克斯的一次非常重大的赌注。)

[Andrew] Yes, they want to make streaming free for everyone, but with advertisements. Many persons now do not want to pay a lot of money every month for different systems. They would rather watch advertisements if the show is free. Fox thinks this is the future of television.
(是的，他们希望让每个人都能免费收看流媒体，但要插播广告。现在很多人不想每个月为不同的系统支付很多钱。如果节目是免费的，他们宁愿看广告。福克斯认为这是电视的未来。)

[Aria] But the value of Fox shares fell after this news. Why? Because twenty-two billion dollars is a very large amount of money. Some persons in the market think Fox is spending too much. They worry that Fox will not make enough profit from advertisements to pay for this big purchase.
(但在这个消息公布后，福克斯的股票价值下跌了。为什么？因为220亿美元是一笔非常巨大的资金。市场上的一些人认为福克斯花得太多了。他们担心福克斯无法从广告中赚取足够的利润来支付这笔庞大的收购费用。)

[Andrew] It is a big risk, but it shows how the business of television is changing. The old ways of sending television through cables are dying. Every big company is trying to find its place in the new system. If you do not change, you will die.
(这是一个很大的风险，但它展示了电视业务正在发生怎样的变化。通过电缆传输电视的旧方式正在消亡。每家大公司都在努力在新系统中找到自己的位置。如果你不改变，你就会消亡。)

[Aria] That is true in business and in life. Now, we must talk about some sad news from the war between Russia and Ukraine. Recently, Russia made a violent attack on the city of Kyiv with flying machines and other weapons. During this attack, a very old and beautiful church caught fire.
(在商业和生活中确实如此。现在，我们必须谈谈俄罗斯和乌克兰之间战争的一些悲伤消息。最近，俄罗斯用飞行器和其他武器对基辅市进行了猛烈袭击。在这次袭击中，一座非常古老而美丽的教堂着火了。)

[Andrew] Yes, this church is a great symbol of culture and religion for the people of Ukraine. It has stood for hundreds of years. Seeing it burn has caused great pain to many persons. It was a holy place, and its destruction is a great loss for the history of the earth.
(是的，这座教堂是乌克兰人民文化和宗教的伟大象征。它已经屹立了数百年。看着它燃烧给许多人带来了巨大的痛苦。那是一个神圣的地方，它的毁灭是地球历史的重大损失。)

[Aria] It is very sad when historical buildings are destroyed in war. They represent the heart of a nation. At the same time, the European Union, or EU, has made new rules to punish Russia. They have put a Russian bishop on their list of persons who are punished. This bishop is known as the private priest of Putin.
(战争中历史建筑被毁是非常令人难过的事。它们代表了一个国家的心脏。与此同时，欧盟制定了惩罚俄罗斯的新规则。他们将一名俄罗斯主教列入了受惩罚人员名单。这位主教被称为普京的私人牧师。)

[Andrew] The EU says this bishop supports the war and uses his position in the church to make persons believe the war is good. The new rules mean he cannot travel to EU countries, and any property he has there will be taken. The EU wants to show that even religious leaders who support violence will face punishment.
(欧盟表示，这位主教支持战争，并利用他在教会中的地位让人们相信战争是好事。新规则意味着他不能前往欧盟国家，他在那里的任何财产都将被没收。欧盟希望表明，即使是支持暴力的宗教领袖也将面临惩罚。)

[Aria] This is a very strong step. Usually, governments do not punish religious leaders. But this shows how serious the EU is about stopping the support for the war. They want to cut off all forms of support, not just military or economic support.
(这是一个非常强硬的步骤。通常，政府不会惩罚宗教领袖。但这表明欧盟对于停止支持战争是多么认真。他们希望切断所有形式的支持，而不仅仅是军事或经济支持。)

[Andrew] This leads us to the relations between global leaders. The G7 is a group of seven chief nations. Their leaders are meeting, and they are talking about how to work with Trump. Trump has said many sharp words about some of these leaders recently. This has made their relations very delicate.
(这引导我们关注全球领导人之间的关系。G7 是由七个主要国家组成的集团。他们的领导人正在会面，他们正在讨论如何与特朗普合作。特朗普最近对其中一些领导人发表了许多尖锐的言论。这使得他们的关系变得非常微妙。)

[Aria] The G7 leaders are trying to plan for a future where they might not be able to depend on the United States as much as before. They want to make their own nations stronger in trade and military power. But at the same time, Trump has said he is happy about the new agreement with Iran.
(G7 领导人正试图为一个他们可能无法像以前那样依赖美国的未来做计划。他们希望在贸易和军事力量上让自己国家变得更强大。但与此同时，特朗普表示他对与伊朗达成的新协议感到高兴。)

[Andrew] So, there is some hope that they can still work together on big problems. It is a very complex game of politics. Each leader must protect their own nation, but they also need to work together to keep the earth safe and prosperous.
(因此，人们仍然抱有一些希望，即他们可以在重大问题上共同努力。这是一场非常复杂的政治博弈。每个领导人都必须保护自己的国家，但他们也需要共同努力，以保持地球的安全和繁荣。)

[Aria] Our last story is from Norway. The son of the Norwegian Crown Princess, Marius Borg Hoiby, has been found guilty of a very serious crime. The judges said he did two violent acts against women. This is a very shocking story for the people of Norway.
(我们的最后一个故事来自挪威。挪威王储妃的儿子马里乌斯·博格·霍伊比被判定犯有非常严重的罪行。法官表示，他对女性实施了两次暴力行为。对于挪威人民来说，这是一个非常令人震惊的故事。)

[Andrew] The royal family is usually very respected. Marius Borg Hoiby has been given a punishment of four years in prison. The judges made it clear that the law is the same for everyone, even if you are from a very important family.
(王室通常非常受人尊敬。马里乌斯·博格·霍伊比被判处四年监禁。法官们明确表示，法律对每个人都是平等的，即使你来自一个非常重要的家庭。)

[Aria] This decision has caused a lot of discussion about the behavior of young persons in high positions. It shows that no one is above the law. It is important for the public to see that justice is done, no matter who the person is.
(这一决定引发了许多关于身处高位的年轻人行为的讨论。它表明没有人可以凌驾于法律之上。让公众看到正义得到伸张是很重要的，无论这个人是谁。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is. It helps to keep the trust of the public in the system of law. When persons see that even the son of a princess goes to prison for a crime, they feel that the system is fair.
(是的，确实如此。这有助于保持公众对法律系统的信任。当人们看到即使是公主的儿子犯罪也要坐牢时，他们会觉得这个系统是公平的。)

[Aria] That is a very important point, Andrew. A fair system of law is the base of a good society. Now, let us look back at all the stories we have talked about this day. We have seen how fast our machines are changing, from Siri to Gemini.
(这是一个非常重要的观点，Andrew。公平的法律系统是美好社会的基础。现在，让我们回顾一下我们今天谈到的所有故事。我们已经看到了我们的机器变化得有多快，从 Siri 到 Gemini。)

[Andrew] Yes, and we have also seen how these changes affect our daily life. When Gemini stops working, we cannot make calls easily. When Apple changes its engines, old programs stop working. We must be ready to learn new things all the time.
(是的，我们也看到了这些变化如何影响我们的日常生活。当 Gemini 停止工作时，我们无法轻松拨打电话。当苹果更换引擎时，旧程序就会停止运行。我们必须随时准备学习新事物。)

[Aria] We also talked about the price of oil and how it fell because of a new agreement. This is a good example of how politics between nations can have a direct effect on our pocket. When leaders make agreements, the price of driving our carriages goes down.
(我们还谈到了石油价格以及它如何因新协议而下跌。这是一个很好的例子，说明国家之间的政治如何对我们的口袋产生直接影响。当领导人达成协议时，我们驾驶车辆的费用就会下降。)

[Andrew] And we saw the sad side of war, with the burning of the old church in Kyiv. It reminds us that war does not just kill persons; it also destroys the history and culture of a nation. We must hope for peace on earth.
(我们还看到了战争悲惨的一面，基辅古老教堂的焚毁。它提醒我们，战争不仅杀人，还会摧毁一个国家的历史和文化。我们必须期盼地球的和平。)

[Aria] Yes, peace is the most important thing. And finally, we saw that the law is the same for everyone, as shown by the story in Norway. No matter how high your position is, you must follow the rules of society.
(是的，和平是最重要的。最后，正如挪威的故事所表明的那样，我们看到法律对每个人都是平等的。无论你的地位有多高，你都必须遵守社会的规则。)

[Andrew] These are all very deep stories, Aria. They give us a lot to think about. For our English learners, these stories are also a great way to learn new words and see how they are used in real life.
(这些都是非常深刻的故事，Aria。它们给我们带来了很多思考。对于我们的英语学习者来说，这些故事也是学习新单词并了解它们在现实生活中如何使用的好方法。)

[Aria] That is true. Learning English is not just about memorizing words. It is about understanding the earth and talking about important things. We hope this talk has been helpful to you.
(确实如此。学习英语不仅仅是背单词。它是关于理解地球并谈论重要的事情。我们希望这次谈话对您有所帮助。)

[Andrew] Yes, thank you for listening to us this day. Keep learning, keep asking questions, and we will see you next time.
(是的，谢谢您今天收听我们的节目。保持学习，保持提问，我们下次再见。)

[Aria] Goodbye from all of us here. Have a very good day.
(我们全体人员在这里向您道别。祝您度过美好的一天。)

[Aria] Good morning. Welcome to our daily news talk.
(早上好。欢迎收听我们的每日新闻对话。)

[Andrew] Good morning, Aria. It is very good to be here with you today to talk about the news of the earth.

[Andrew] To run these machines, you need a lot of computer power and big buildings with many electric brains. This grid will cost 295 billion dollars!
(要运行这些机器，你需要大量的计算机算力和拥有许多电子大脑的大型建筑。这个网格将耗资 2950 亿美元！)

[Aria] It will use technology made inside China. This is a very big step for their science and computer power. It will help them be independent of other countries.
(它将使用中国国内制造的技术。这是他们的科学和计算机力量迈出的非常大的一步。它将帮助他们独立于其他国家。)

[Andrew] There is also interesting news about travel in China. The Rainbow Mountains in Zhangye have become a very busy place.
(关于中国的旅游也有有趣的新闻。张掖的彩虹山已经变成了一个非常繁忙的地方。)

[Aria] These mountains are in the northwest of China. They are made of different colors of stone and sand that have been pressed together for millions of years. The wind and rain have shaped them into beautiful curves.
(这些山在中国西北部。它们是由不同颜色的石头和沙子经过数百万年的挤压而成的。风和雨把它们塑造成美丽的曲线。)

[Andrew] When the sun shines on them, they look like a painting. It is a natural wonder. But because of social media, millions of persons want to visit them.
(当太阳照在它们上面时，它们看起来像一幅画。这是一个自然奇观。但由于社交媒体，数百万人想要参观它们。)

[Aria] During big holidays, thousands of travelers arrive at the same time. This has created a lot of pressure on nature.
(在重大节日期间，成千上万的游客同时到达。这给大自然带来了很大的压力。)

[Andrew] Yes, they have built wooden paths for persons to walk on to keep the land safe. If you step on the delicate stone, it can take sixty years for the color to come back.
(是的，他们建造了供人行走的木质通道以保护土地安全。如果你踩在脆弱的石头上，颜色可能需要六十年才能恢复。)

[Aria] This shows how domestic travel is changing in China. Persons love to see beautiful nature, but we must also keep it safe for the future.
(这展示了中国国内旅游的变化。人们喜欢看美丽的大自然，但我们也必须为未来保护它的安全。)

[Andrew] Now, let us talk about world news and conflicts. The G7 leaders are having a big meeting in France.
(现在，让我们谈谈世界新闻和冲突。G7 领导人正在法国举行一次大型会议。)

[Aria] The G7 is a group of seven rich countries: the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, and Canada. They meet every year to discuss the biggest troubles of the earth.
(G7 是由七个富裕国家组成的集团：美国、英国、法国、德国、意大利、日本和加拿大。他们每年开会讨论地球上面临的最大麻烦。)

[Andrew] This year, they are talking a lot about the war in Ukraine. The war between Russia and Ukraine has been going on for more than two years. It has caused a lot of destruction and death.
(今年，他们花了很多时间讨论乌克兰战争。俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争已经持续了两年多。它造成了巨大的破坏和死亡。)

[Aria] The G7 leaders have agreed to boost Ukraine's air defenses. This means they will send more machines to shoot down Russian missiles and drones in the sky before they hit houses and hospitals.
(G7 领导人已同意增强乌克兰的防空能力。这意味着他们将发送更多机器，在俄罗斯的导弹和无人机击中房屋和医院之前，在空中将它们击落。)

[Andrew] They also want to make the rules against trade with Russia tighter. This is to stop Russia from getting money for the war.
(他们还希望收紧针对与俄罗斯贸易的规则。这是为了阻止俄罗斯获得战争资金。)

[Aria] President Trump was also at the G7. He has a different view. He said that the war in Ukraine has no impact on the United States because it is far away.
(特朗普总统也在 G7 会议上。他有不同的观点。他说乌克兰战争对美国没有影响，因为它很遥远。)

[Andrew] This statement surprised some other leaders. There was even a moment when President Macron of France and President Zelensky of Ukraine were heard talking about Trump when they did not know their microphones were on.
(这一表态让其他一些领导人感到惊讶。甚至有那么一刻，法国总统马克龙和乌克兰总统泽连斯基在不知道麦克风开着的情况下，被听到在谈论特朗普。)

[Aria] Yes, they were heard saying that they are worried about Trump's plans and what he will do. This shows the tension between the leaders.
(是的，他们被听到说他们担心特朗普的计划以及他会做什么。这显示了领导人之间的紧张关系。)

[Andrew] Finally, we have news from Australia. A right-wing leader named Pauline Hanson said that multiculturalism has failed.
(最后，我们有来自澳大利亚的新闻。一位名叫 Pauline Hanson 的右翼领导人表示，多元文化主义已经失败。)

[Aria] Multiculturalism means having many different kinds of persons from different countries living together in one nation. Australia is a country built by persons from many different places.
(多元文化主义意味着让来自不同国家的许多不同类型的人生活在一个国家。澳大利亚是一个由来自许多不同地方的人建立的国家。)

[Andrew] After the original people, many came from the United Kingdom, then from Europe, and now from Asia and other parts of the earth. This has made Australia a very multicultural society, with many languages, religions, and foods.
(在原住民之后，许多人来自英国，然后来自欧洲，现在来自亚洲和地球的其他地方。这使澳大利亚成为一个非常多元文化的社会，拥有许多语言、宗教和食物。)

[Aria] Pauline Hanson believes that this has caused trouble for Australia's society and that different groups do not mix together. She says it makes the country divided and weak.
(Pauline Hanson 认为这给澳大利亚社会带来了麻烦，不同的群体没有融合在一起。她说这使国家分裂和软弱。)

[Andrew] But most Australians do not agree with her. They believe that having different cultures makes their life richer and helps Australia trade with the rest of the earth.
(但大多数澳大利亚人不同意她的观点。他们认为，拥有不同的文化会让他们的生活更丰富，并有助于澳大利亚与地球其他地方进行贸易。)

[Aria] They believe that harmony is possible when we respect our differences. This is a big discussion that is happening in many countries today.
(他们相信，当我们尊重彼此的差异时，和谐是可能的。这是当今许多国家正在进行的一场大讨论。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is a very important question for the future of our earth.
(是的，这对于我们地球的未来是一个非常重要的问题。)

[Aria] Well, that is all the news we have for today. We hope you enjoyed our talk and got some new English words.
(好了，这就是我们今天的全部新闻。我们希望你喜欢我们的谈话，并学到了一些新的英语单词。)

[Andrew] Thank you for being with us. Keep listening and keep getting knowledge!
(谢谢你和我们在一起。继续收听，继续获取知识！)

[Aria] Goodbye!
(再见！)

[Andrew] Goodbye!
(再见！)

item.title: 2026-06-18 Daily News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning, Andrew! We are very happy to be here with our friends today.
(早上好，Andrew！我们今天非常高兴能和我们的朋友们在这里。)

[Andrew] Good morning, Aria! Yes, it is a beautiful day to have a talk about the news of the earth.
(早上好，Aria！是的，今天是个讨论地球新闻的美好日子。)

[Aria] Our friends are learning English, so we will speak in a simple way. We will use simple words to make everything clear.
(我们的朋友们正在学习英语，所以我们将用简单的方式说话。我们将使用简单的词汇来让一切变得清晰。)

[Andrew] That is right. We want to help every person who is listening to get more knowledge of English and the earth today.
(没错。我们希望帮助每一位正在收听的人，在今天获得更多关于英语和地球的知识。)

[Aria] Let us start with our first story from the technology group. It is about a big company named Adobe.
(让我们从技术板块的第一个故事开始。它是关于一家名为 Adobe 的大公司。)

[Andrew] Yes, Adobe makes electric systems for pictures and moving pictures. Many persons use these systems for their work every day.
(是的，Adobe 制作处理图片和动态画面的电子系统。许多人每天在工作中使用这些系统。)

[Aria] Now, Adobe is putting a new AI helper into their programs. These programs are Premiere, Illustrator, and InDesign.
(现在，Adobe 正在将一个新的 AI 助手放入他们的程序中。这些程序是 Premiere、Illustrator 和 InDesign。)

[Andrew] This is a very big change. Premiere is a system for making moving pictures. Illustrator is for making drawings and art. InDesign is for putting words and pictures on pages of books.
(这是一个非常大的变化。Premiere 是一个制作动态画面的系统。Illustrator 是用于制作图画和艺术的。InDesign 是用于将文字和图片排版在书页上的。)

[Aria] With this new AI helper, a person can talk to the machine. The person can say, "Make this picture blue," or "Make this line straight."
(有了这个新的 AI 助手，人可以和机器对话。人可以说，“把这张图片变成蓝色，”或者“把这条线变直。”)

[Andrew] Yes, and the machine will do the work in a second! It makes the work very quick. Before this, a person had to use their hands and spend many hours to make a small change.
(是的，机器会在一秒钟内完成工作！这让工作变得非常快。在这之前，一个人必须用他们的手，花好几个小时来做一个小小的改变。)

[Aria] I remember when I first used Premiere to make a moving picture. It was so hard! I had to cut the moving picture with a digital knife and move the parts with great care.
(我记得我第一次用 Premiere 制作动态画面的时候。那太难了！我必须用数码刀剪切动态画面，并非常小心地移动各个部分。)

[Andrew] Yes, it was a very slow process. Now, you just say "cut this part" and the AI helper does it. It is like magic!
(是的，那是一个非常缓慢的过程。现在，你只需说“剪切这一部分”，AI 助手就会完成。这就像魔术一样！)

[Aria] But some persons have a feeling of fear. They have a thought that they might lose their work because the machine is so quick and does not need payment.
(但是有些人感到害怕。他们认为自己可能会失去工作，因为机器太快了，而且不需要报酬。)

[Andrew] That is a serious thought. But other persons say that this AI helper will give workers more free time to have new ideas. It is an adjustment to a new way of working.
(这是一个严肃的想法。但其他人说，这个 AI 助手将给工作者更多自由的时间来产生新的想法。这是对新工作方式的一种调整。)

[Aria] Yes, it is a development of technology. We must see how persons use it in the future.
(是的，这是技术的发展。我们必须看看人们未来会如何使用它。)

[Andrew] Now, let us talk about another technology story. It is about a very famous play for electric machines. It is named Grand Theft Auto VI.
(现在，让我们谈谈另一个技术故事。它是关于一个非常著名的电子机器游戏。它名叫《侠盗猎车手 6》。)

[Aria] Oh, yes! Many young persons and even older persons love this play system. It is a very big event because the company, Take-Two, has given the day when persons can pay for it early.
(哦，是的！许多年轻人甚至年长的人都喜欢这个游戏系统。这是一个非常重大的事件，因为 Take-Two 公司已经公布了人们可以提前付款的日期。)

[Andrew] Yes, that day is June 25. Persons can make a pre-order on that day. They also showed the cover art of the play.
(是的，那一天是 6 月 25 日。人们可以在那天进行预订。他们还展示了该游戏的封面艺术。)

[Aria] The cover art has a picture of a young man and a young woman. They are standing near a road carriage in a great town. It looks very beautiful and bright.
(封面艺术有一张年轻男子和年轻女子的图片。他们站在一个大城镇的道路车辆旁。它看起来非常美丽和明亮。)

[Andrew] This play has been in development for many years. The last play, Grand Theft Auto V, came out more than ten years ago!
(这个游戏已经开发了许多年。上一个游戏《侠盗猎车手 5》是在十多年前推出的！)

[Aria] That is a very long time. The company has made a great amount of money from it. When they said the pre-order day, the stock value of the company went up very quickly.
(那是非常长的时间。该公司从中赚取了巨额资金。当他们公布预订日期时，公司的股票价值迅速上涨。)

[Andrew] Yes, the market is very happy about this news. It shows that many persons have a strong desire to play this new game.
(是的，市场对这个消息非常高兴。这表明许多人有强烈的愿望去玩这个新游戏。)

[Aria] Our third technology story is about YouTube. YouTube is testing a new design for its mobile machine program.
(我们的第三个技术故事是关于 YouTube 的。YouTube 正在测试其移动机器程序的新设计。)

[Andrew] Yes, and some persons might not like it. It changes the buttons on the viewing glass.
(是的，有些人可能不会喜欢它。它改变了显示屏上的按钮。)

[Aria] Why would they hate it, Andrew?
(他们为什么要讨厌它，Andrew？)

[Andrew] Because of muscle memory! Muscle memory is when your body does something without a conscious thought. Your finger knows where the button is because you have pushed it thousands of times.
(因为肌肉记忆！肌肉记忆是指你的身体在没有意识思考的情况下做出某种动作。你的手指知道按钮在哪里，因为你已经按了成千上万次。)

[Aria] Ah, I see. If they move the button, your finger will touch the wrong place. That can make a person angry or tired.
(啊，我明白了。如果他们移动按钮，你的手指就会碰到错误的地方。这会让人生气或疲倦。)

[Andrew] Yes. YouTube wants to make its program look more like TikTok. They are hiding some text labels and even hiding the dislike button again on some short moving pictures.
(是的。YouTube 希望让它的程序看起来更像 TikTok。他们正在隐藏一些文本标签，甚至在一些短视频上再次隐藏了“不喜欢”按钮。)

[Aria] They want persons to keep watching and watching without stopping. It is a competition between big companies.
(他们希望人们不停地看下去。这是大公司之间的竞争。)

[Andrew] Yes, but they must be careful. If the behavior of the program is too strange, persons might stop using it.
(是的，但他们 must 小心。如果程序的行为太奇怪，人们可能会停止使用它。)

[Aria] Let us talk about a smaller but very happy change. Google Calendar is giving its users more color choices!
(让我们谈谈一个较小但非常令人高兴的改变。谷歌日历正在给其用户提供更多的颜色选择！)

[Andrew] Finally! For many years, we only had a few simple colors like red, blue, green, and yellow.
(终于！许多年来，我们只有几种简单的颜色，比如红、蓝、绿、黄。)

[Aria] Yes. Now, they have a full RGB picker. This means you can make any color you want for your events.
(是的。现在，他们有了一个完整的 RGB 调色板。这意味着你可以为你发生的事件制作任何你想要的颜色。)

[Andrew] This is a great win for persons who love organization. You can make your work meetings one shade of blue, and your family dinners a soft shade of orange.
(对于热爱整理的人来说，这是一个巨大的胜利。你可以把你的工作会议设为一种蓝色，把你的家庭晚餐设为柔和的橙色。)

[Aria] It seems like a small adjustment, but it makes the system much more beautiful and personal.
(这似乎是一个微小的调整，但它让系统变得更加美丽和个性化。)

[Andrew] I agree. It is the small things in our daily life that can give us comfort.
(我同意。正是我们日常生活中的这些小事能给我们带来舒适感。)

[Aria] Now, let us move to our business and finance news. This is about the money system of the United States.
(现在，让我们转向我们的商业和财经新闻。这是关于美国货币体系的。)

[Andrew] Yes, the financial markets are looking at a man named Kevin Warsh. He might become the new chief of the Federal Reserve, which is the big central bank of the United States.
(是的，金融市场正在关注一个名叫 Kevin Warsh 的人。他可能会成为美联储的新任主席，美联储是美国的大型中央银行。)

[Aria] The markets are saying he might be very hawkish. What does "hawkish" mean in simple words, Andrew?
(市场说他可能非常“鹰派”。用简单的词来说，“鹰派”是什么意思，Andrew？)

[Andrew] In the language of money, "hawkish" means a person wants to keep interest rates high. They do this to stop the prices of things from going up too fast.
(在货币语言中，“鹰派”意味着一个人想要保持高利率。他们这样做是为了防止物价上涨过快。)

[Aria] But high interest rates can make it hard for persons to get money from the bank to buy houses or start businesses.
(但是高利率会使人们很难从银行获得资金来买房或创业。)

[Andrew] Yes, it makes money tight. The markets expected that the Federal Reserve would make interest rates lower. But if Kevin Warsh becomes the chief, he might keep them high for a longer time.
(是的，这会让资金变得紧张。市场原本预计美联储会降低利率。但如果 Kevin Warsh 成为主席，他可能会在更长时间内保持高利率。)

[Aria] This has caused some worry among traders. They have to make adjustments to their plans for the future.
(这引起了交易员的一些担忧。他们必须对未来的计划做出调整。)

[Andrew] But Kevin Warsh has said he will make decisions based on facts, not because of what political leaders want. He wants to keep the bank independent.
(但 Kevin Warsh 表示，他将根据事实做出决定，而不是因为政治领导人的意愿。他希望保持银行的独立性。)

[Aria] That is very important for the balance of the money system.
(这对于货币体系的平衡非常重要。)

[Andrew] Our next story is very good news for many persons. The average price of gas in the United States has fallen below four dollars!
(我们的下一个故事对许多人来说是个非常好的消息。美国汽油的平均价格已跌至四美元以下！)

[Aria] That is wonderful! Why did the price of gas fall so quickly?
(那太棒了！为什么汽油价格下降得这么快？)

[Andrew] It is because Donald Trump, the leader of the United States, has signed an initial agreement with Iran to end their conflict.
(这是因为美国领导人唐纳德·特朗普与伊朗签署了一项结束冲突的初步协议。)

[Aria] This agreement will reopen the Strait of Hormuz. This is a very narrow water passage where many big ships carry oil across the sea.
(该协议将重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。这是一个非常狭窄的水道，许多大型船只通过它跨海运送石油。)

[Andrew] Yes. When the passage was closed, persons had fear that there would not be enough oil. This fear made the price of oil very high.
(是的。当通道关闭时，人们担心石油不够。这种担忧使得石油价格非常高。)

[Aria] Now that the agreement is signed, those fears are gone. More oil can flow to different countries, so the price of gas goes down.
(现在协议已经签署，那些担忧消失了。更多的石油可以流向不同的国家，所以汽油价格下降了。)

[Andrew] This is a great help for families. When gas is cheap, it costs less money to drive to work or go on a journey.
(这对家庭来说是一个巨大的帮助。当汽油便宜时，开车上班或去旅行花钱就更少。)

[Aria] Yes, and it also makes the price of food and other goods lower, because transport is cheaper.
(是的，它还降低了食品和其他货物的价格，因为运输更便宜了。)

[Andrew] But not all financial news is happy. The stock of SpaceX has taken a sudden dive.
(但并非所有的财经新闻都是令人高兴的。SpaceX 的股票突然大跌。)

[Aria] SpaceX is the famous company of Elon Musk that makes flying machines to go to the stars. Why did its stock fall?
(SpaceX 是埃隆·马斯克著名的公司，制作前往星空的飞行机器。为什么它的股票会下跌？)

[Andrew] Well, SpaceX had a very big IPO, which is when a company sells its parts to the public for the first time. At first, there was a great frenzy. Every person wanted to get a part of the company.
(嗯，SpaceX 进行了一次非常大的 IPO，也就是公司首次向公众出售其股份。起初，出现了一股极大的狂热。每个人都想分得公司的一杯羹。)

[Aria] Yes, the price went up very high. But now, that frenzy is losing steam.
(是的，价格涨得非常高。但现在，那股狂热正在失去动力。)

[Andrew] The value of SpaceX fell below the value of Amazon. Traders are expecting that the stock will move up and down a lot next week.
(SpaceX 的价值跌至亚马逊的价值以下。交易员预计下周该股票将大幅上下波动。)

[Aria] It is a natural reaction after a very big rise. Sometimes, the price goes up too fast because of hope, and then it must fall back to a normal level.
(在非常大的上涨之后，这是一种自然反应。有时，价格会因为希望而上涨得太快，然后它必须回落到正常水平。)

[Andrew] That is true. It is about balance. SpaceX is still a very strong company with great technology, but the market must find its true value.
(那是真的。这关乎平衡。SpaceX 仍然是一家拥有伟大技术的非常强大的公司，但市场必须找到它的真实价值。)

[Aria] Even with the SpaceX fall, the general stock market had a very good week. The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all went up.
(即使 SpaceX 下跌，整个股市本周也表现非常好。道琼斯指数、标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数全部上涨。)

[Andrew] Yes, the optimism about the Iran peace agreement was stronger than the worry about interest rates.
(是的，对伊朗和平协议的乐观情绪强于对利率的担忧。)

[Aria] It is interesting to see how different news events fight against each other in the minds of traders.
(看到不同的新闻事件在交易员的心中互相博弈，这很有趣。)

[Andrew] Yes. Peace is always good for business. When countries are not fighting, they can trade more, and there is less danger for transport.
(是的。和平总是对商业有好处。当国家不打仗时，他们可以进行更多的贸易，运输的危险也更小。)

[Aria] That is why the market posted gains for the second week in a row.
